title: Ahhh....Finally relief!!
text:
I'm indebted to the company that made this. I had been dealing with incessant itching on my upper back. It was exactly where I was unable to scratch it. I Did find though that using something like a back scratcher just made the itching worse.

After searching through the back scratchers being sold through Amazon, I settled on this particular one. Finally some relief!! In total, this scratcher is 30 inches long (75cm) which gives an adequate amount of surface area to scrub my back. Each end has a loop to hold onto and they make it very easy to use (looping it around your fingers/hand works much better than using your thumbs). One side has the scrubbing surface and the other side is a terry cloth surface, similar to a washcloth. I've used body wash with this product and have found that it rinses well.

One thing I've found that worksbest is to use this scratcher after I've completed my shower. At this point your skin will be softened which will make it easier to slough away. As I stated before, this rinses well but I take extra time after I use the scrubbing side (to try and remove any dead skin...ick). It also seems that my back scrubber dries easily (I hang mine from a hook and leave in the shower). I've only used this a couple of times, so I haven't put it through the washing machine yet. So their is an explanation to what many people are calling fake reviews. A year or so ago I started taking this vitamin at the time I noted the large amount of unverified reviews. Amazon lets anybody write a review if you make an account to verify that you don't write multiple, but amazon also sometimes lets companies transfer reviews on their reputation. If the review doesn't say "verified purchase" it means that they didn't buy the product on amazon. Also, though I don't see the error now you may have seen the date that a bunch of reviews were moved to amazon being written as the date the review was written it is a simple error. Take note I bought my vitamins directly from Dasgro to get them cheaper in bulk, so you won't see "verified purchase" next to my name, but because my review wasn't transferred from the company that makes Dasgro you can see my other reviews.

Though, I haven't seen any hair regrowth (I suffer from the rarest form of alopecia areata eyebrow and facial hare loss) they are just good vitamins, and in less than one month I lost a bunch on warts that had been spreading on my hand that I had been trying to get rid of for over a year. Then before the second month was out a huge clump of fungus fell out of my nose this was in the spring. The winter before (winter 2014/2015) I had gotten two sinus infections and been sick many times. After taking the full dosage for a month, and taking half the dosage for two more months, and since taking about one pill every two or three days (which I intend to continue forever) I haven't been sick once. Also, you can have too much of anything, and that said I think you will get the best results from not taking a high dose (recommended dose) of this vitamin for more than a short time. Also, please take note this is after I lost most of the hair on my head and gave up eating gluten which helped with many other problems I had and spurred regrowth of my hair. title: The jury is still out
text:
I got this because my loved one keeps getting DUIs and has no clue how much alcohol will get him in trouble or how long it stays in his system. And because this one is inexpensive and rechargeable.

I tried it out on myself when it first arrived, and got .02 once and then consistently 0.0 after that.

Last night my loved one had 2 large mixed drinks, so we gave it a test when we got home. I blew various numbers, including .19. I had not been drinking at all. After blowing several times, I got 0. Then gave to my loved one, and he blew 0. He tried again and blew .19 a few times. Then I blew .19 again.

I was all set to return it, but decided to try again this morning, 10 hours later. The results are more believable this time. He still has some alcohol in his system, .03. I'm 0.

Comments:
1. Make sure the device is fully charged.
2. My loved one seems to have a hard time not blowing spit into the device.
3. The device retains breath from one time to the next. If I blow after my loved one, I register >0, but if I do it again, I get 0. If he got a lot of spit in the machine, I get lower values each time I blow until it gets down to 0. If he blows after me, he registers less than after he blows a second time and subsequent times.
4. It's easier to blow directly into the tube on the device than into one of the mouthpieces, bug the mouthpieces do trap some of the moisture.

I've got another couple of weeks to try it out, but I think it's going to work ok. I suspect .19 may be the upper limit?

title: Good Thing 2 Bottles Came with the Package
text:
Fall and Spring every year, I suffer from allergies, which often lead into sinus infection. I use NetiPod squeezable bottle to rinse out my nasal passages, and thought this product is a good fit for me evaluate the effectiveness.

The sample package came with two bottles. Each bottle has two dispensing nozzle and a cap. The bottle’s bottom has a tactile button to engage air valve to allow air to flow into the bottle when dispensing the rinse solution. There was no discernable leak from the valve when the bottle was sitting up. The flow of water is adequate for rinsing. If additional pressure is desired, a slight squeeze to the plastic bottle will increase the solution pressure/flow. Overall a smart designed product, and I can see the use of this bottle.

However, I noticed that there was a thin piece of plastic chad inside the bottle hanging from the air valve. I am sure it would be safe, but not having a quality control on the health product was concerning. Frankly I did not feel 100% safe to use the product, so I threw away the bottle was I reviewing, and decide to use the second bottle that did not have a chad.

title: Value For Price
text:
I really appreciate the simplicity of install and operation of this relatively inexpensive UV Air Purifier.

First of all, all those that have issues with the templet ---- Buy a decent Tape Measure ----learn how to Read, Measure and Use the Tape Measure or, at the very least, find someone knowledgeable that can Show You How to Read and Use a Tape Measure ---- The Tape Measure IS your Friend...

A few extremely Simply measurements will save a Ton of ill reviews. After I Measured and RE-Measured the base unit and compared it to the template, I felt I was 99.997% accurate and confirmed the manufactures template measurements were very very close ... using a digital caliper I was able to get within .030 of the pencil marks I made on the template ---- close enough for the girls we dated in High School ---- utilizing a piece of standard 3/4 inch painters masking tape --- I again measured, with a tape measure, the EXACT Center of my "After A-Coil Duct" and carefully -- but skillfully -- using an ULTRA FINE TIP SHARPIE, marked the center location on the Duct --- using very Simple Math (not common-core bs) I found the distance from the Center of my Duct to the Center of the lamp holder on the base unit and the Center of the Hole on the template and marked the duct carefully....I did this for BOTH Lamp Holes.... Being in the Electrical Service field for many years, I had thee exact size hole saw required AND recommended by the manufacture --- Buuutttt -- I choose to error on the side of caution and use a 1/4inch larger diameter hole saw ---- juuusssttttt incase my "math" was off a little ( I had some adhesive backed foam tape I was prepared to use IF the holes were too far off or out of round ).

I gingerly drilled a pilot hole with a #35 drill bit for the Center of Each Lamp in the Duct and taped the manufactures templet to the duct utilizing the measurements previously mentioned ----- I was astonished and to my amazements the Tape Measure I used earlier to measure the locations of the center of the holes were Spot on to the Template!!!! Henceforth, and with wild abandon, I installed a Hole saw in my Cordless drill and drilled through the ductwork above the A-Coil --- being extremely careful NOT to let the hole saw cut all the way through the thin sheetmetal, --- I didn't want to play "go fish" for the cutout in the bottom of the duct ----- I cut through about 2/3rds - 3/4s of the duct and used a pair of pliers to bend the cutout back and forth until it separated from the duct and removed the "burrr" with a piece of emery cloth.

The mounting screws used to fasten the unit to the duct didn't fit holes in the unit ----- soooo, again using the tape measure and a sharpie, I carefully but strategically measured and marked the mounting hole location on the duct, and used a #35 drill bit to predrill the holes for the mounting screws----- again spot on --- once the mounting screw holes were drilled I placed the unit on the duct and made sure ALL the mounting Holes lined up ---- if they didn't line up, I feared it would be a "Do Over" either above or below or left or right of my original measurements.... no big deal, after reading many ill reviews of the mounting template being off -- I was prepared for the worse --- adjusting my location ----whew--- luckily all was good, due to my superior tape measuring capabilities.

I used latex gloves and installed the lamps into the lamp holder being extremely careful to avoid touching either lamp. Everything lined up and after using extreme care utilizing the manufacture supplied screws, I mounted the Unit to the Duct and plugged the unit in.

Oh Man !! All Good !!

Unit powered up, and has been working non-stop since install. Eventually I will install a current switch or air-flow switch to regulate the lamps power up when the blower energizes during heat cycles or cooling cycles.

I gave this 4 Stars because I don't know the longevity of the lamp life based on how often it will cycle on...we will see

I really hope this is a helpful review for all those DIY'rs.

title: Nice smaller mop for quick daily use...
text:
I searched a long time for the mop I needed...
At least 2 removable/washable pads included
Small enough format for rinsing in the sink
Vertical storage of head, so we could put it in kitchen broom closet...freshly wrung out.
a color that was not obnoxiously bright for my kitchen

This broom fit all of those criteria. My cats are messy eaters of wet food, so it's either clean up the floor in that area every day, or clean mats AND the floor, because with mats, food often still ended up on the floor.

CONS of this:
1. Arrival/Assembly: It arrives in parts and if you've never had a mop like this (we hadn't), it is not obvious how the parts go. First, part of it was put together just for shipment, and we struggled mightily to take it apart just to be able to assemble it properly. (There were no instructions for that first act, so one immediately feels stress.) Then, the very poor instructions were small line drawings that were difficult for my older eyes and not obvious. Upon enough studying of the pics, I was able to figure out how it should be...but by then, my impatient daughter had already put it together incorrectly based on false logic and we were afraid it would break as we tried to undo it for proper assembly.
2. When mopping, it does fill somewhat flexible/flimsy, my daughter and I can't come up with a word for it. But I think it may be that the plastic parts aren't that firm, so it just feels like it might fall apart if you put too much pressure on it. That said, it does work. Just not sure if it will be for very long. I suspect the pads will outlast the mop.
3. This is perhaps more assembly, again, but it took us awhile that one end of the pad has to be "fitted" onto the mop head or the pad won't stay put when using the wringer feature. The line drawing provided did not make this clear to us, or we just didn't "get" the drawing.

PROS:
This mop did satisfy all of my factors listed above.
1) Storage is cool...wring it out and store it vertically in broom closet. The wringing out is good enough that I can place it immediately in the cupboard after use. My "better" microfiber mop does not store with the head vertical like that, and it is too big for my small broom closet.
2) Washing and Wringing out in kitchen sink with the faucet and faucet sprayer works great. It's JUST small enough that I don't have to make a huge spraying mess all over...with a bit of care, no water overspray goes anywhere.
3) The microfiber pads are excellent.
4) For small, quick, daily chores, it is very nice. My use was the cat food area...I just spray the area with some vinegar/Dawn/water mixture, wait a few minutes and come back with this mop (dry from the cupboard), go over it a few times and it gets most of the cat food off the floor after a 3-4 minute soak. Occasionally, I have to rough up a spot or two. I usually rinse and repeat the mopping and then rinse, wring out and back in the cupboard.
5) The price was very fair, under $25 with Prime Delivery. If it lasts me a year, I would buy it again...even though I truly would rather pay $10 more and have a forever mop with replaceable/purchasable pads. The world just doesn't work like that anymore, though.

The eco-friendly box was easy to open and use. The nozzle didn’t drip so there was no mess. However, I still prefer to use a bottle because I don’t like the residue associated with using a cap.

title: Good basic cleaner
text:
Review for: Green Earth Probiotics Multi-Purpose Cleaner | Professional Strength Enzyme Cleaner | Pet Stain and Odor Eliminator | Drain maintainer | Urine odor remover | Surface and Carpet cleaner | | Made in USA | 1 Gallon

I have not yet had the opportunity to challenge this cleaner with a really tough stain but I can say that it is a nice all around cleaner. It does a nice job on kitchen counters, kitchen sinks and bathrooms. It has a light scent that is pleasing and does not smell at all like harsh chemicals. I have even been able to clean my stainless steel garbage can lid and was left with a clean lid and no streaks. It also leaves the faucets shiny.

title: Fit my toothbrush
text:
Review for: Replacement Heads for Philips Sonicare Electric Tooth-Brush 10 Pack, MERUYOO for Phillips All Snap-On Handles, C1 C2 C3

These brush heads fit my toothbrush. They are a bit different than the originals but still seem to do a good job. I like that the package includes 10 so I don’t need to order so often. They don’t have any identifying marks is you are using the same handle for more than one person. They do all have covers though.

title: Better than nothing but can’t hold a candle to the hydro flosser
text:
Review for: CITAITAI Water Flosser Cordless, Protable Water Flosser IPX7 Oral Irrigator for Teeth, Gums, Braces, Dental Care,with 4

I have used a hydro flosser for years and have been very happy with it. I am now searching for a replacement with a price tag that is under $100. While this device does put water between the teeth and around the gums, it does not have any where near the needed pressure to do a really good job. The hydro is like using a pressure washer and this flosser is like turning the faucet on half way.

It has a bit better pressure using the hose and cup method but the hose tends to come flying out of the cut and create a mess.

title: Love the light, hate the design
text:
Review for: Red & Infrared Light Therapy Belt for Body Pain Relief Wearable Light Therapy Device with 2 Wavelength

I have been using a red light pad on my shoulder for quite a while it has made a huge difference. I have a bit of arthritis in my back and thought I would try it on my back. While I love the light for my back, the design of this belt and the controls is poor.

The controls are built into the red light part of the belt rather than on the cord. This means that once you put the belt on, the controls are on your back, unless you have an 18” waist like the model in the photos. Like most red lights, this one decides to turn off now and then. If/when that happens, you won’t know it because you can’t see the controls because they are on your back. The controls themselves are poorly designed with three lights that can be lit up for the settings. The problem is the light leak so if one light is lit up, so are the others and you can’t tell what setting you are on. They need to go back to the drawing board on this one.

title: Red light therapy has worked on my shoulder
text:
Review for: USUIE Red Light Therapy Belt, 660nm & 880nm, Near Infrared Light Therapy Device for Body,

I have been using a smaller red light therapy pad for my shoulders and it has made a difference. This larger pad allows me to treat my back. Because I do not need to be plugged into an outlet, I can be on the move while using this device. That is a huge plus for me. The elastic strap keeps the pad where I need it and I can put the power bank, not provided, into my pocket or use the pocket that is included.

The results from this device don’t happen overnight but at least for me, they do happen. This pad has several options and as you hit the mode button, the light with change from red, blue, green or white. These colors correspond with the different modes. I use mostly the green setting.

The entire kit arrives nicely packed into a gift box, making this a presentable kit if you are giving as a gift.

title: The vibration button makes all the difference
text:
Review for: Special Supplies Vibrating Ball Pillow Sensory Pressure Activated for Kids and Adults, Plush Minky Soft Cover with Textured

Without the vibrating button inside this pillow, it is just a soft, retro looking, roundish pillow. It is exactly the right size to put on your lap and use as a desk for a tablet. That alone makes it handy. Add the vibration device and it opens up another world of interest. If you hold the pillow up to your body and squeeze just right, the vibration happens. There is a very soothing feeling that comes about when feeling that significant vibration happening near your heart. I can see why it is attractive to kids with special needs. In fact, my kids fight over it, they all love using it and they are about as normal is it gets.

I like the design of the button. It is quite large so is easy to activate from outside the pillow. It uses 2 AA batteries and then has an on/off button. The best part is that you still have to press to activate so just because it is in the on position, it is not running all the time and eating batteries.

title: Work well on screens but work better with a microfiber cloth to dry
text:
Review for: ULTRA CLARITY Eyeglass Lens Cleaning Wipes 30-Pack, Moist Towelettes, Glasses, Phone & Electronic Screens, Optic Surfaces, Ideal Even on Coated Surfaces, Silicone-Free, Safe Professional Grade Formula

I have tried a lot of different wipes and these do a good job if you have a microfiber cloth to finish drying the screen or lens with. I have found that few wipes can really do the job without being wiped to eliminate smears. These are very handy to have around, particularly when traveling or in the car where you don’t have a spray bottle of cleaner.

title: Not bad for a travel flosser but not the best choice for everyday use
text:
Review for: Miracleplus Professional OLED Display Water Flosser for Teeth, Cordless Dental Oral Irrigator for Travel &Home

I have been using a water pik type of water flosser for years and it has always been able to remove bits of food from the places that dental floss does not. When using it, I am also able to keep the sink area dry. Because of this previous experience, I have pretty high expectations for water a flosser. While this type of flosser is much more portable, it is also much less powerful. I have not seen it remove any food that the regular floss does not. Obviously the tank is much smaller but I don’t mind that too much because it is easy to refill. I do like the convenience of not having the cord.

I have two issues with this flosser and the first is the water that drips from it during use. By the time I am finished, I have water all over the counter. The 2nd is the lack of power. I don’t feel that I am getting the gum area of my teeth really clean because the water does not have enough force.

title: Works great
text:
Review for: Neti Pot Sinus Rinse Bottle Nasal Nose Wash Cleaner 500ml X 2Bottles, Sinus Wash Nettie Pot Family Set

I very seldom have a cold or any congestion but when I do, I get out my neti pot and rinse the nasal cavities with salt water. This has always cleaned up my congestion quickly. Neti pots are a bit of a pain to use though and this device is much simpler.

The set of bottles does not come with any instructions but looking at the product page answers the questions if you have any. Instead of tipping your head upside down over the sink with the neti, this device allows me to stand up and tip the bottle instead. Water runs through the nasal passages and cleans them out.

I suggest using only distilled or boiled and cooled water with some salt. Also, the bottles must be super clean or you can cause an infection . I like that you get two bottles in this set because you can always have one clean and ready to go.

title: Very disappointing
text:
Review for: Noise Reduction Earplugs- 2 Pairs of Reusable Flexible Silicone high-Fidelity Hearing Protection earplugs for Sleep, Snoring

I am very disappointed in these ear plugs. I thought they might be effective in blocking a lot of the noise from power equipment such as my lawnmower or weed eater. I also expected them to be good quality because of their price. Sadly, upon using them I found them to be less effective than the foam plugs that come 12 in a jar for a third of the price. They barely block any noise. While wearing them, I can still hear the person next to me speaking in a normal voice.

I thought the case alone might be a nice perk but it is made of cheap plastic and is very difficult to open.

title: Not labeled properly for use in the USA
text:
Review for: (3 pack) Zinc Gummies Immune Support Booster Chewable Dietary Supplements Immune Gummies Promote Growth Wound

The bottles that these gummies are in are not properly labeled for sale in the US. There is no manufacturer or distributor listed anywhere on the label. I do not know what country they are from. That alone erodes my trust in this company.

The other issue that is a bit alarming is that the information on the label does not match what the product page states. I have no idea which one is correct.

Because of the two issues above, I can not recommend these gummies.

title: Not properly labeled for sale in the US
text:
Review for: 3 Packs) Vitamin D3 5000 IU Gummies for Adults - Support Immune,Healthy Bones,Joint Pain, Muscle Function, Teeth

When I receive vitamin orders there are a number of things that I check on the label. These bottles fail almost everything that I normally look for.

The company has failed to put the name of the distributor or manufacturer and their address on the bottle so I have no idea where this product is sourced from or made.

I checked to see that the label matched what the product page states about the dosage. The page states that the dosage is 5000IU but the bottles label says 200IU.

Rather than go into more detail on the discrepancies, it is quicker to simply point out what items from the label match the product page. The gummies are strawberry flavored.

At this time I can not recommend these gummies.

title: Made in the USA
text:
Review for: Turmeric Curcumin + Ginger - Maximum Strength Turmeric Capsule Supplement with Ginger Extract and Black Pepper

The dosage of this product is one capsule so the bottle is expected to last for two months. The ingredients do include black pepper, an important piece of this supplement. This is a helpful for people with joint issues.

The capsules are made in the USA. My bottle arrived well sealed and without a child proof cap. The lot number and expiration date are located on the bottom of the bottle.

title: A+ because it works so well
text:
Review for: Lint Remover, Brush for Pet Hair to Remove Dog or Cat Fur from Furniture Like Couch, Cat Bed, with Self-Clean

I have a light colored cat and a dark colored recliner. Between the two, I constantly have cat hair that needs picking up and I go through a lot of lint rollers. This little gadget works quicker and more efficient than the lint rollers. On top of that, I don’t have to constantly purchase refills.

I was a bit skeptical on how well the holder actually cleaned the removal tool. Much to my surprise, it does a nice job and deposits the cat hair in the bottom the holder. I then can just pull it out and dispose of.

Five stars!

title: Shorten drying time
text:
Review for: NGZD.HM Wool Dryer Balls in Dia. 2.76'',100% New Zealand Wool,Reusable Natural Organic Fabric Softener,Soften Laundry

I have been using dryer balls for years and can’t imagine not using them. They do need to be changed out every now and then though. These dryer balls work as well as any that I have used. I just toss them in the dryer and forget about them. They not only reduce my dryer time but I have less wrinkles when I take my laundry out. I also hardly ever use fabric softener because of the dryer balls.

title: Powerful supplement
text:
Review for: Balance Breens Fisetin + Quercetin 650mg - Supports Cognitive Function, Vitamin Supplement for Graceful Aging - Immune Support Powerful Antioxidant - 30 Non-GMO Vegan Capsules

I have been taking Quercetin for a while and believe in it’s benefits. Fisetin is new to me and after reading about it, everything that I have learned is positive. This seems like an excellent combination. The only concern I have is not knowing the amount of Fisetin vs Quercetin in the dosage. It is possible to overdose on Quercetin so I would have preferred to have the amounts listed separately.

My bottle arrived double sealed and with an expiration date on the bottle. This product is made in the USA.

title: 2 or 6 capsules per day?
text:
Review for: Potent Garden Immune Support -Quercetin with Vitamin C and Zinc Elderberry Supplement C

These capsules contain a lot of things to really boost the immunity. They are fairly large but still go down ok. My only concern is the dosage. In one place on the bottle it states that the does is 2 capsules per day and in another it says to take 6 per day. I guess everyone would need to assess the situation and take what they think is right by reading the % of daily values on the bottle. Other than Vitamin D, this combination does seem to have everything that I take for immunity.

The bottle says that the product is formulated in the USA but not where it is made. When I read something like this, I usually assume it is made in China and the company does not want to state that. In this case, I would only be guessing on that information.

title: Flexible and they stay on
text:
Review for: JJ CARE Adhesive Knuckle Bandages and Fingertip Bandages [Pack of 100] Fabric Knuckle Bandages - Elastic, Flexible Fabric

I have been using these fingertip bandages on my finger and they work very well to cover up a new cut. They go on easily and do the needed job. The adhesive sticks well and the bandaid packages are easy to open.

The knuckle bandaids are even better. They allow the finger to bend without the bandage coming off.

title: Arrived sealed with expiration date
text:
Review for: Daily Bone Strength - Organic Calcium Supplement, Vitamin D3, K2, BioPerine for Improved Absorption.

My ingredient label has different percents than the one in the photo on the product description. The photo shows 1250% of D3 and my label has 625% of D3. The other items are about the same. Either way, that is a whopping dose of D3 and a tiny dose of calcium. I know we are supposed to get most of our calcium from what we eat but aren’t we also supposed to get most of our D3 from the sun? Because the ratio is so diverse, I have little control on how much I take of these two things when using this product.

The bottle arrived sealed and with an expiration date.

title: Do a good job of cleaning glasses
text:
Review for: Ultra Clarity Eyeglass Cleaning Wipes - 30 Pack

These cleaning wipes are super handy for travel or just to keep in the car. I also keep a few near my reading chair. It seems that when I sit down to read, I almost always notice that my glasses need cleaning.

The wipes do a surprisingly good job of cleaning glasses without leaving streaks. Having tried other wipes and found them wanting, I was a bit surprised to see how well these wipes work. I definitely recommend them. 5 stars.

title: Slow to dissolve, nice amount of fizz
text:
Review for Handmade/ Handcraft Bath Bombs with Natural Essential Oils, Shea Butter, Sea Salt, Spa-Quality Products

My bath bombs arrived in a nice gift box. The box included 6 bath bombs, artificial rose petals and a large pink heart that I believe is another bath bomb. There was shredded paper in the box to dress it up a bit. The entire presentation was nice and ready to be gifted.

The bath bombs had only a slight scent. They create a nice amount of fizz when they enter the water. I was surprised how long they take to dissolve. They do turn the water the color of the bomb. I found them to be enjoyable to use and a bit moisturizing.

title: Easy to use by myself
text:
Review for Blood Pressure Monitor,Accurate Adjustable Digital BP Cuff Kit & Automatic Upper Arm Machine

I found this blood pressure machine easy to use by myself. Because of the way the cuff is designed, it is easy to get on and off alone. The numbers on the screen are large enough to read easily if you have the voice mode turned off. If you have the voice mode on, the machine will not only tell you what your BP is but also it plays music. I find this annoying and so keep mine on mute.

Comparing this cuff to my other one, I found it to be quite accurate. It also checks for an irregular heartbeat.

What I did find a bit strange was that the machine did not come with batteries even though the package had a form fitting area for the batteries. It also did not come with a micro USB charging cable even though there is a port for one and the instructions show you how to use it. It works well with the charging cable, you just need to provide your own.

The cuff does come with a fabric storage bag.

title: Protects an injured finger
text:
Review for EvridWear Dustproof Polypropylene Finger Cots, Finger Protector, Finger Sleeves for Hand Eczema, Finger Cracking, Finger Injuries and More, Natural White

I wanted these finger cots to protect an injured finger when I am gardening. After trying bandaids that simply come off when wet or with use, bulky bandages that also come off and rubber gloves that make my hands sweat and then the bandaid comes off and gets stuck in the end of the glove, I was quite frustrated. The last thing I wanted was fresh soil or garden debris getting into a cut day after day.

These cots are the answer. I can put a simple bandaid on, cover it with the cot and then wear my regular garden gloves because the cots are not bulky. They allow my finger tips to breathe and even if they get wet, they don’t come off.

I like that they are in graduated sizes and also on a cardboard hand cut out so I can easily choose the correct on for my finger. They can also just go in the washer with my other laundry.

I highly recommend these for anyone that deals with the same issues.

title: Great for cleaning my glasses
text:
This is a review for FG Clean Wipes Non-Woven Polyester/Cellulose Cleanroom Wipes for General Cleaning.

I found these wipes to be excellent for cleaning my glasses. They are also great for cleaning mirrors or small windows because they have no lint. Any quick shine need they can take care of. When I am having guests, I can shine up the bathroom faucets quickly and easily.

Because these are so small, I keep a few in the car and when I realize that I can’t see through my glasses, I can clean them.

Each piece is fairly small at 9x9, perfect for a lot of jobs. The wipes are strong and don’t want to tear but you can certainly cut them if you choose to. They are not real absorbent so not the best choice for picking up water, etc.

These are definitely an asset to have in the home.

title: Nice product
text:
This is a review for OGANA CELL Sky Blue Toner 4.4 fl.oz.

I am a fan of this toner. It is soothing and seems to be effective without any stinging and tingling. The liquid is clear and appears to have no scent other than possibly a very light one from some of the ingredients.

It is easy to dispense by just shaking the bottle upside down onto my cotton round. It doesn’t take much to apply so it will last quite a while.

When this toner arrived, it had a tiny plug in the dispensing hole. I was glad to see that because clearly the product had not been tampered with and it helped to prevent leakage during shipping.

title: Close shave
text:
I have tried several electric shavers and none have been able to give me as smooth and close a shave as a basic manual razor does. This one comes really close. You get a pain free close shave in record time. The shave has a nicely shaped body that makes it easy to hang onto even with wet hands. It has not caused me any skin irritations.

The shaver comes with a charging cable and a brush for cleaning. Mine had a good charge when it arrived and recharging is done in 1-2 hours if it is totally dead.

title: Very coarse
text:
For coarse sanding blocks or nail buffers these are OK. There is nothing about them to stand out, but they do the job fine on acrylic or gel nails. They do lack a side that has a fine grit for natural nails.

I use these as cleaning tools and the coarse texture works well to remove lime or hard water marks on porcelain. They can also be used as sanding blocks. With small woodworking projects that need just a bit of touch up, these do the trick. I have even used these in my gardening. Some of the larger seeds need to be clippped or sanded before they can germinate and these work ok for that project.

title: Love the side with the bristles
text:
This brush has a long enough handle to reach my back easily. I like that it has a hole in the handle with a rope so that I can hang it. The sticky hook that comes with the brush actually does a good job of sticking to the tile in my shower.

I love the side of the brush that has regular bristles. The other side has some knobby things that I don’t care for. The bristle side is not only great for washing my back but also for dealing with an itch at other times.

The brush comes in a box and has a cellophane wrap around it, making it suitable to gift wrap.

title: Smaller than your average cotton ball
text:
I am not sure what makes these cotton balls premium. I believe they are smaller than your average cotton balls. They do feel a bit firmer though. They come in a resealable bag and obviously have been bleached because when cotton is picked, it is not this white. I do appreciate that they have no lotion or anything else in them.

They are made in China and I believe they are quite pricey.

title: Just OK
text:
These glasses are just OK, nothing fancy. I like the frames but the lenses have room for improvement. They are a bit blurry around edges. They are still usable for me because I only use them when using the computer and that is straight ahead.

The frames fit well but they do not have springs so are more likely to break.

title: Does a good job
text: This shaver does a nice job of removing hair. It comes with the needed accessories, including another head. The directions give a general description on how to use the different parts of the shaver. They do not mention the other head and how to change it out. I feel that is something that should have been included in the instructions.

title: So easy to use
text:
I love the convenience and ease of these laundry sheets. If I were someone that used a laundromat, I would be very happy to use these rather than drag along a bottle of detergent every time I went. Even at home, there is no mess with spilled detergent or trying to measure detergent. There is also no residue left in the washer from powder detergent.

The sheets do as good a job on my laundry as the detergent that I had been using. I also have not noticed any scent on the sheets or on my clothing when it comes out of the washer or dryer.

title: Made in the USA
text: These gummies have a surprisingly good taste, must better than others that I have tried. They not only have the apple cider vinegar but also B vitamins. You only need one a day so they go a long way. It is a huge plus that they are made in the USA.

title: I am a fan
text:
I found that using this with my mask makes wearing one much less annoying. It keeps the mask from pushing right against my mouth and nose. Most importantly, it keeps my glasses from fogging up.

It works will will the couple of different basic masks that I have tried but I like it best with a double layer mask that I have. There is an opening between the two layers and I can put the bracket inside the opening. Now it stays in place and I don’t have to think about it when I remove the mask.

title: Strong and rather unpleasant scent
text:
I applaud this company for creating a concentrated and eco friendly detergent. The use of a box and a bag within it is quite different but there are very clear instructions on the outside of the box. There is even a spot to store the measuring cup on top of the box. There is a warning about how fast the detergent dispenses but I was still quite surprised with my first use and had an over full measuring cup. Unfortunately, there is no way to pour the detergent back into the box.

As for the detergent itself, it seems to do a good decent job of cleaning and no one in my family has shown any signs of irritation. However, there have been complaints of the scent. The scent is strong and while the washer is going, the detergent smell is noticeable in that part of the house. The scent is less strong after the wash is done but the clean and dry laundry still has a faint smell.

title: Quality device at good price; lifetime warranty
text:
This was the only neck traction device I could find with a pressure gauge that was at an affordable price. Other inexpensive models don’t offer the gauge, making it impossible to tell what pressure you are using and to systematically increase the pressure.

The device is good quality and works well and there are no problems with the pump mechanism and pressure gage working properly. It is as comfortable as one can expect from something like this.

As instructed, I emailed the company for a lifetime warranty. One of their employees emailed back within a day to confirm the receipt of my email, noting “if you encounter problems such as disconnection, breakage, etc, during use, please contact us to get a brand new product for free.” Having that kind of service is pretty impressive.

Highly recommended.

title: Miracle-worker!
text:
This spray is a miracle-worker for stinky shoes. Here is our background before we started using Sprayzee. My husband had major funk issues with his shoes. The smell was terrible and embarrassing if he needed to take off his shoes in front of other people. We tried buying several pair of shoes and alternating them but that didn't work. We were getting desperate. My husband even started feeling nauseated at the smell after several hours in his office.with his shoes.
We saw Sprayzee on amazon and its high reviews. We ordered it and sprayed it ~7 times in all his shoes (leather dress shoes and tennis shoes). The shoes only smell like Sprayzee which smells like a natural citrus-mint essential oil. We love that the shoes don't stink anymore! We are very happy with this affordable solution to controlling shoe funk. It's super easy to use. Just spray inside the shoes toward the toe and also toward the heel and let it dry overnight. It would be nice to have a travel friendly size because we aren't going anywhere without this stuff. I definitely recommend this.

title: Yummy addition to coffee and smoothies!
text:
I discovered collagen powder a few months ago when my friend heard about it online. It is rumored to have really crazy good effects on joint pain and digestion concerns. It does so much more than that!

I am a 27 year old female with connective tissue disease that causes hypermobility in the joints. I have the least severe type of the disorder which means most people just start taking narcotics to help with the joint pain stemming from the joints coming out of socket frequently. I didn't want to be in my 20s and strapped to a narcotic pain med for the rest of my life. I worked through the pain, went to physical therapy, did yoga etc. It all helped, but I still found myself taking muscle relaxers on the regular to help out which turned my stomach into a nightmare of it's own.

I started collagen powder and the first week I was disappointed, like anyone with a chronic problem I wanted to start feeling better immediately! Week two I noticed less stomach problems. Like significantly. I could eat food without fearing the wrath of my digestive tract. Week three I noticed my hair was softer, fluffier, and felt like it was snapping less. Week four I realized I grew my nails out for the first time in my whole life. Week five I didn't have to ice my hands after teaching and writing on the board. Week six I was running without knee pain and woke up the next day without needing a muscle relaxer.

I don't think an over the counter product has ever made such a difference in my life. This powder specifically has a great taste and is easy to mix in to my morning coffee without thinking about it. If you have joint pain, stomach issues, brittle hair/nails, or skin issues...try it. It blows biotin out of the park I promise you!

title: Give it more than a week to see best results
text:
Editing: I am now less confident these work. They have stayed plugged in since my initial review but in the past month we’ve seen a huge uptick in millipedes and beetles. I’m guessing the initial results I saw could have just been been due to weather fluctuations changing insect patterns.

We recently moved to the country with an old barn/workshop that had been largely untouched. It was full of a wide range of bugs and lots of evidence of past rodents - from skeletons to fresher poop. Though my SO was skeptical, I was desperate enough to try anything - particularly as the chemicals in the sprays we were having to use constantly were aggravating my lungs. I didn’t notice much difference for a week - perhaps just saw more beetles and a few extra spiders and lizards, which the company says can happen for the first week. I decided to stick with it and see what happened and actually have been impressed in the second and third weeks. It is winter, it is possible this is a normal eb and flow, but compared to what we were seeing for the entire month of October, we are probably seeing a 70-90% reduction in critters.

I use it, but it needs to be reapplied several times a day for maximum effectiveness. Maybe in the winter it would be better since I am less greasy and the wax may be more likely to stay more solid, but this does melt pretty quickly.

It's not a bad product, but I do wish it would last longer. Don't know if reformulation would help. The shape of it is fine for me. I get the idea of it being shaped like lipstick, but do to the nature of how it is used and it's consistency I think it's fine as is. I am going to hunt around if I repurchase (which is likely) because I think 11 bucks is kind of steep.

Also, make sure to wipe it off or be very careful when you clean your lenses. It makes a super mess if it gets on them.

title: Somewhat heavy. Breathing isn't quite as easy.
text:
I'm actually surprised that this fits me as well as it does. I got this to use when spraying chemicals in the yard because of its filter pads and the velcro-type strap that goes around the head to hold the mask tighter. Another benefit of the strap is that because it does most of the work holding the mask on, the loops don't cut into the ears like most masks.

I got another brand without the filter pads and strap at the same time because it was available in XL and this one only came in Medium.

Yet despite the difference in sizes, this medium fit about the same as the XL of the other brand, including the ear loops, except that the other one came about a half inch further down my throat.

This one says that its nose clip "prevents fogging of glasses", but it still fogged some, especially with heavy breathing. It was a little bit better at reducing fogging than the other brand, but that's it.

Naturally, due to the filter pad in this one, this mask is a little heavier and felt like breathing with it was not as easy.

Nevertheless, when spraying chemicals, I would definitely trust this make more than one without a filter.

title: Long review- giving it a second try
text:
I purchased the 3 bottle set( 90 days). Im one bottle in and things are going ok. I take 4 daily with no stomach irritation or other problems. The pills dont taste that good and start dissolving upon contact with water. I take them with lots of water. So far my shedding as increased and is causing me concern. I haven't seen a change in the condition of my hair or balding areas yet and no uptake in growth rate either.

Of note, I was already taking most of the ingredients listed as contained in Toji in other supplements. So I expected this to kick in quicker since I have the vitamins, herbs and minerals already in my system for the last several (6-8) months. That hasn't happened but I'm Still hopeful , I will update in another 30 days.

Updated_ July 27

Two days away from concluding my second bottle and so far....I have no increase in my hair growth ( i only get 1/8" a month) , no increase in shine ( my hair's still frizzy and unruly) or thickness either( still thinning with bald spots). I have increased shedding and breakage since I started to take these, which is upsetting to me. My fingernails do seems to grow fast but that is all that I have noticed. I am not happy with my experience taking these so far.

Update August 28- added stars to my rating.

Beginning my fourth bottle and I'm finally noticing a betterment in my hair. It still grows slowly but I have noticeably growing hair at my edges. Shedding and breakage has decreased and my hair seems a little thicker. . It looks much better than it did three months
ago or even one month ago.

Update at 4 months: September 25

Still no faster growth and only minor thickening. I've reduced my dosage to half... One in the morning and one in evening and so far no change in the condition of my hair.From my last update. i think ive gotten all I'll get from these. I plan to continue two a day for the time being until I can find something else.

Final review october 2013

I no longer take these. I saw only minor improvement in the condition of my hair after almost 5 months at high dosage, which was four a day. My fingernails grew pretty fast but that's it. I saw no regrowth in bald/thinning areas and no change in growth rate either. I've stopped taking them and so far, nothing happened. No shedding or breaking etc. Seemed they weren't that effective for me. Very pricey fail.

February 2014 second try

I'm desperate to stop my hair loss so I'm giving these another try. It seems they were effective in slowing my loss and some increase in thickness. Since I stopped taking them it seems my hair went back to very thin. It took about three months to show. So if this worked and I didn't notice it's worth a second try. I need it bad because nothing else is working. I started two a day for one month January and now back up to 4 for the next three. I will update in 30.

title: Very Skeptical
text:
I purchased priteva as a possible replacement for nioxin recharging complex. I've taken one tablet daily for about 45 days and have seen no results. No increase in shine, no faster growth and no thickening. I expected that if the product actually contains the powerhouse ingredients listed on the label... I'd see some evidence of taking it.

I was skeptical about taking this product as it seem too convenient that the ingredients listed are so close to the discontinued nioxin formula which is selling at very steep prices right now. There is very little information on the web about the true manufacturer of the product or where or how its made.There are very few reviews and those that I did find, seemed to be from the same posters on different websites. Most of the posters indicates that they were either paid or given a free bottle to try. There is absolutely no follow up on you tube or hair boards from these users to support success or any results using priteva. Just seems shady to me.

Of note... The RDA information is listed on the product as "results not established" which is interesting since the product includes very basic and widely accepted vitamins that most certainly have a RDA so what would've been the problem with listing it on the label? Again, seems shady to me.

I will not buy it again.
**
update march 2013

I've taken one a day for 4 months( two 60 count bottles) with no noticeable increase in growth or thickness of my hair. My opinion is that even though the product label lists its ingredients almost identical to that of the discontinued recharging complex, it doesn't provide the results I got with nioxin. title: Benedryl for pennies, at least that's why my doctor says!
text:
I take Benedryl each night, to help with nighttime allergies. I've been doing this since forever, and once I realized this wasn't a "couple of days and you're cured" kind of thing, I asked my doctor if I could use a generic in place of the brand name drug. She explained that the FDA makes sure that the drugs are pretty much identical, and in the case of Benedryl, you don't have to be as exact as you need to be with some other drugs.

So, I sleep better, snore less and have a slightly heavier wallet. No downside that I can see!

title: Let Me Clear Some Things Up...
text:
This wedged seat cushion is much better than several of the reviews are giving it credit for, especially for the price!

Because of this, I feel I should address some of the specific concerns mentioned in the other reviews...

FIRMNESS: At first glance, this cushion seems very stiff because it is. If you weigh less than 115 lbs or are very sensitive to firm seats, you may want to look elsewhere for a softer cushion. However, for the average person, the initial firmness slowly gives way as you sit in it and offers a nice balance of support and cushioning, rather than disappearing beneath you as some softer cushions do! Also, as anyone who has owned memory foam products knows, the stiffer foam should hold up better over time. My wife is 125 lbs and uses hers all day, every day, as a receptionist in a busy office. She loves it! And it's still supportive enough for me to use, despite me being a much bigger and heavier person.

SIZE: The stated measurements are spot on. This is NOT a "large" or "extra large" cushion, much more of a "medium" size. In fact, it says "mini" in the product title, so anyone thinking they were getting a huge cushion simply wasn't paying attention, ha ha!. That said, it's not really "mini" either. It's a nice versatile size that will fit most kitchen and office chairs, as well as car seats. I'm a tall guy with a wide 38" waist and my wife is naturally "curvy" where it counts...while we definitely wouldn't want this cushion to be any more narrow than it already is, neither of us has difficulty getting comfortable on it.

ANGLE: Someone complained that they didn't like the fact that the cushion was "angled". Well, it says "wedge" in the title and it clearly shows the heavily angled profile in the picture! This is great for keeping you from sinking backwards into chairs too deeply and also relieves pressure on nerves and arteries in your thighs by decreasing their angle. Of course, not everyone likes the feeling of an angled cushion, but if you bought this thinking it was a straight cushion, you should probably get your eyes checked! Also, just because you don't like the shape, it doesn't mean the cushion isn't a good value, because it is!

If you want a "soft" cushion, a "straight" cushion or are worried about the overall width, feel free to look elsewhere, but be ready to pay more!

Personally, I'd probably opt for a slightly wider cushion myself if I was going to buy another, but my wife and I still have no complaints about the overall performance and quality of this product. Recommended!

title: Where's the light?
text:
I bought this lamp and have owned it for all of two days. When I took it out of the box, it was immediately apparent that the quality of build is exceptional. This includes not only the plastic stock, the metal pole and the extra stout internal and external power cables, but also the superb packaging.

But, unfortunately, when I turn the light on, the issue surfaces: just as the Hawaiian reviewer below notes, the "natural" light is white, dim, and very directed to the area under the lamp. I am typing this review under the light, and find it uncomfortable to even see the keyboard. And I have perfect, eyeglassless vision. It is unnaturally white and glaring. Although it has two intensity levels, there is an odd, Twilight Zone glare to this light. I see nothing "natural" about it at all, and frankly, after using it for a couple hours last evening, I had a headache. I have another light by a different manufacturer that looks almost identical, but was 50% the price of this Verilux, and it casts a pleasing yellow glow that I find stellar for reading. I much prefer that light.

I may well use this Verilux in my bedroom reading chair because, admittedly, it will be good for directed light that is less likely to wake my wife than the more general cast of an incandescent bulb. And perhaps I will grow used to this freakish Verilux beam that makes me feel like I'm in a surgical suite about to have my tonsils out or something. But for now, high marks for structure, low marks for light. Agree with two stars of reviewer below, but added one star for the great construction and looks good with burl finish and detachable shelf. But if I can't read by the reading light, what good is it?

title: Softest Cleasning, Gentlest Exfoliation
text:
I'm very happy that I saw this 3 pack of konjac facial sponges before I hastily clicked on a lesser deal!! This pack includes a regular konjac sponge (white), a green tea (green, fairly obviously), and black (charcoal). Green Tea has anti oxidant, anti inflammitory, and anti rednes benefits for the skin. Charcoal is purifying and detoxifying for the skin. Regular is regular :D All gently exfoliate the dead skin cells off for smoother, healthier skin that is able to fully absorb all the beneficial ingredients from all the products you pay good money to put on your skin! All of them also help to decongest the pores, rid them of impurities, which will minimize or all together prevent clogged pores which can turn into blackheads, whiteheads, and acne. While there is no medicated ingredient to treat acne in the actual sponges, exfoliating and decongesting the pores regularly is perhaps the very best thing someone can do to prevent acne. As a Licensed Esthetician, I would not recommend using any type of konjac sponges on open acne or severe excema or psoriasis. Acne, excems, and psoriasis should be treated with medicine. But with that disclaimer, I will emphasize that these natural, plant based sponges are the gentlest material available today! The sponges are each shaped like a half globe or sphere. This provides a nice soft, round surface area to clean forhead, cheeks, etc, but then also has an corner edge that goes around the sphere to get into the little folds of the nose and other little places that always needs some extra exfoliation.. The sponges consist of 100% plant material. The all natural plant fiber has a slightly slick, almost rubbery feel to it. It is far softer than a loofa, and softer than even the softest wash cloth. The sponges are hydrophillic, or drawn to water, ("water loving" to be exact) and extremely absorbant! The consistency of the sponges also encourages more lather from any lathering cleanser that you use with it. This can help you to use less product with each use, and thereby save a little money by making your cleanser last longer.

I'm a Licensed Esthetician and for as strongly as I believe in, and advocate for, Exfoliation! I am perhaps an even bigger advocate to : BE GENTLE WITH YOURSELF!!! Konjac sponges are absolutely brilliant at cleansing, mildly exfoliating, removing make up, and helping to dislodge any clogs from the pores...all while being THE MOST GENTLE WAY TO CLEANSE YOUR FACE, NECK, AND DECOLOTTE...EVER! I also firmly believe that when you ENJOY using a product, yu are far more likely to use the product regularly. And consistency is the magical ingredient to any skin care routine. I was fortunate that I was able to purchase this product at a discounted rate in exchange for my honest and unbiasd review. As wonderful as these konjac sponges are, they do not last forever! They last, with daily use, about a month. Those of us who have sensitive skin (raises hand!! lol) and use a sponge only every other day or a few times a week, will enjoy longer use from each konjac sponge. When you first get them, inorder to "activate" it, you need to soak it in a bowl of water for about 20 minutes. Which is really just hydrating the deeply dehydrated, so dry they are infact crispy, dry sponges. Oh...and here is my last tip. Haha. KEEP AWAY FROM DOGS AND PETS BECAUSE MY DOG FOUND ONE TO BE DELICIOUSSSSS. I am not sure about cats but I wouldn't trust them either, hahaha! Now I only know the wonders of the green-green tea and black-charcoal konjac sponges, BECAUSE my four year old min pin mix dearest pet puppy was ENAMOURED and then OBSESSED with my new sponges. Long story shortened, my beloved dog was devious, plotted, and had the wherewithall to finally get and EAT my white-regular konjac sponge. I'm sure all the fiber helped make him regular, lol. I was not worried at all for his safety when he ate my safe, non toxic, natural, 100% plant fiber regular konjac sponge though. At least there's that. I was, however, bummed that he removed that one right out of MY beauty regimine. I am totally enjoying the other two. They are so gentle, and literally, the more gentle the better for my very sensitive skin.

And to end on a serious note: the less pulling and tugging you do on your skin today...is less fine lines and wrinkles you will have later, one day.

title: A close to perfect TENS device.
text:
After more than a decade of using TENS machines and this is my third. Frankly, I have been very happy with all of them and this one is no exception. While a TENS treatment does not cure permanently but it does give such relief and it’s so reassuring to know that you have this tiny, portable machine that can make a such difference. (I don’t use either EMS mode nor massage mode, but they are available in this machine).

What I like about this one is that it has a size and shape that easily slips into a pocket. It is so intuitive to use you almost don’t need the very clear and almost perfect instruction booklet. I say “almost” because there are some things left unexplained. They weren’t explained in my old unit either but I had hoped to gain some insight now and didn’t.

The cables that attach to the electrode pads have red and black tips. Like with jumping cables, red is positive and black is negative. The placement diagrams give no explanation as to why sometimes polarity matters and sometimes it doesn’t. Another gap is that no explanation is given as to the difference between program parameters. My old machine had 4 program modes, this one has 6. I’ve always assumed that P1 is weaker than the higher levels, but it’s never explained.

Other than that, even if this is your first TENS machine, you’re going to find it easy-to-use and you will be comfortable with it from the get-go. It is logical and doesn’t waste your time having to choose a body part like other devices. This is a ridiculous choice. Once you set the time, the program mode, and the intensity of treatment the machine will provide the exact output you selected anywhere you place the electrode pads.

The treatments are excellent—deep and intense--but, if you’re used to another device, the output modes are not standardized between devices. An output mode (strength of the pulsating current) set to 5 on this one is the equivalent of a setting of 15 on my previous one. This unit has a feature that allows you to set the duration of treatment, although I’ve found the default of 30 minutes is ideal. It provides the relief you need, a longer time doesn’t really seem to add any benefit.

It comes with two channels which means that two cords can be plugged in with two sets of electrode pads placed on different parts of the body. Maybe you want to treat your neck and lower back at the same time. Or you can use both sets of pads around one painful area. This is a scenario in which the positive and negative charges come into play, so check the diagram for that body part or the shape you want to use (like containing your painful area within a square).

I have a pacemaker. While my doctors didn’t feel that the TENS waves would interfere with it, I still took the unit to my cardiologist’s office and had the technician check. They ran the pacemaker interrogator without the TENS and again with the TENS placed at shoulder level on the opposite side of the pacemaker and there was no interference. You might want to take a similar precaution for your own peace of mind.

Other than the info I wish had been included in the booklet, my only other objection is that the sticky pads have to be stored on easy-to-lose transparent thick paper holders. If you drop it or put it on your desk, you lose it. A thicker, plastic holder should be provided. These pads are expensive and must be protected. For these two deficits, I’ve deducted one star to an otherwise close to perfect TENS machine—probably the best I’ve had when it comes to performance.

title: I so wanted to like this, but it gets stuck. A lot.
text:
I used Roomba robotic vacs for years, but because they're so pricy and would require so much maintenance, I eventually gave up on them when the batteries started going bad. But when I saw the Hoover name on a similar product, I was excited to give it a try. I was sadly disappointed--this unit is inferior to the Roomba (iRobot) products I had 10 year ago.

The main issue with vacuums like these is that they get stuck. On all KINDS of things. Edges of rugs. Rug fringe. Floor mats. Dog bowls.Anything that can capture a wheel will stop it in its tracks. So in order to make it work, you can end up redesigning your interior decor--removing a throw-rug here, moving the dog bowls up on the counter every morning, picking up the floor mats or buying a different style, etc. Ultimately, it ends up being no more convenient than just vacuuming regularly with a stick vacuum or other lightweight vac.

Beyond the vacuum getting stuck every few minutes on its maiden voyage, I could never get it connected to the iPhone app that's supposed to be used to control it. The app simply never recognized the vacuum, and there were no instructions on how to put the vacuum into pairing mode, if such a thing is necessary. So I gave up on that.

If you have a uniform surface that you need vacuumed regularly, with nothing on it that'll trap the vacuum, then this seems like it might be helpful. Honestly, though, if I were going to purchase one of these, I'd buy one of the top-rated iRobot Roomba models.

title: Colonic Board and Matching bucket
text:
I wanted to get on here and write a full review because I was scared to death of this thing and had buyers remorse the second after I hit "Submit order". I couldn't have been any more wrong in my life. I started reading the reviews and I will speak for myself. I thought the site said I would be emailed the directions once the order was placed. I wasn't so I contacted the seller (Raw Diet) and they wrote back immediately saying the instructions come in the box. Well I got the box today, used the board and bucket today. Here is what happened. First of all I am 5 feet 9 inches tall and I am 133 pounds (before doing this thing) The board was light. I can not say how light because I did not weigh it but if I had to guess I would say about 10 pounds. I had no issues at all lifting it what so ever. The bucket was even lighter. I made a few mistakes so I am going to cover them as well. Before I read the instructions I pulled the sleeve off the tube (I don't know why I did- but I did) It was a B!T@# to get back on, so don't do that. Secondly, My bathroom is not small and I had no problem with space. But if you have a small bathroom this may be an issue. Measure before you buy it. I used this vanity stool to put under the board and CLEARLY on the instructions it says use a chair a few inches higher then your commode. Well... That is for very good reason. Gravity is your friend when you are doing this. To lay flat means nothing moves in a natural motion (Down to the toilet) Once I got going, I felt water on my lower back. I immediately started gagging even though it was only water I had no idea what "it " was at that point and just the thought made me sick. Since it was my bathroom I had bath towels handy and I rolled four up and leaned to rectify this issue. I will definitely use a taller chair next time. I filled the blue bucket up, and used only half the water because that was 45 minutes for me. I have had a professional colonic many times and it lasts about that long. So I knew what to expect. Even if there were not instructions this was possibly the easiest thing to figure out. Its one tube for Gods sake. Two ends of the tube.... its not rocket science at all. So reading the bad review that there were no instructions panicked me (seriously) and then I got it, DUH!
Fill the water bucket with 98-99 degree water so you do not shock your system. Hook one end of the tube to the water bucket, stick the tube through the hole in the curved part of the board and then attach the plastic thingy (that is the medical term) to it and add lubrication to it and you are good to go. I got myself familiar with the water shut off plastic clip before I put water in it so I wouldn't have any weird mishaps. Worse then water being on my back :) I did do several courtesy flushes for myself because I am cool like that. When I was done, I jumped in the shower and cleaned it all up with bleach. Then I weighed myself. 128 HA. I did not buy it to loose weight at all. I bought it because my Mom just died of Liver cancer and I read more then I should ever have had too about how to prevent it. I am trying to stay on top of the health game that's all. I hope this helps.

title: Grabs My Fine Hair Well But Lacks A Cool Setting Needed To Smooth, Lock In Style & Prevent Damage
text:
I have fine hair that lacks body, but still gets frizzy. I blow my hair out and use a round brush or use a blow dryer brush to add style and body and also smooth out the frizz. This Kinga Blow Dryer Brush isn’t the first blow dryer brush I’ve used and like others it’s a low wattage dryer (only 1000 watts) that dries and styles better after I let my hair partially air dry so it’s just damp rather than wet when I use the dryer. It dries and adds style from a combo of hot air and the hot air heating up the inner barrel.

This dryer has a large oval shaped brush with stiff plastic bristles that grab my fine hair well enough that I can get the tension I need to style my hair. But I still don’t get smooth hair and can’t lock in style and body as the unit lacks a cool air setting. The lowest setting before “off” blows warm air, so I’m not getting the quick cool down I need and my hair continues to get heat from the hot barrel and warm air. In addition to that creating styling issues, I’m concerned my fragile hair may get heat damage as the barrel ends up staying hot too long.

The sliding control does turn the unit off and works as described with low, medium and high settings. But I feel it misses the mark as the low setting should be a cool not warm, and the medium setting feels more like a low setting with weak air flow. I need the high setting as my hair is so resistant to holding shape and body, but I’d normally toggle between high and a cool setting for hold and to prevents damage but this lacks that option. That feature is a deal breaker for me, so I can’t fully recommend this dryer. The dryer may be fine for those who don’t use a cool setting. I can’t gauge durability at this time. 3 stars.

title: Looks Nice But Can’t Find A Way To Simply Toggle Back & Forth B/T Desired Cool & Warm Settings
text:
I have fine, dry, flat hair that gets frizzy at the ends. I blow dry with a large round brush and need to switch back and forth between warm and cool settings often to style my hair. I wrap my hair around the brush barrel, blow it with heat and then use a cool setting to lock in shape. I’m constantly switching between and heat and cool settings. But I haven’t found a practical way to do my routine with this Eniseca hair dryer. This hair dryer makes a good initial impression based just on looks in that it’s lightweight, nice looking in black with rose gold, compact, digital and comes nicely boxed with accessories. But I’ve tinkered around with it for days and can’t find a workable way to toggle back and forth between my desired warm and cool settings. I haven’t been able to properly style my hair once with this dryer.

To explain, the heat setting comes on at 50 C, but I need it at about 76 C (max is 99 C). I have to press the plus button 26 times to get my desired heat level. After drying a section, I need a cool burst of air so I switch to cool air, but it defaults to 99 wind power. That’s way too strong, so I have to press the minus button 20 times or so to get a reduced usable air flow. It takes more time to adjust to the cool air flow than to actually use it. The worst part is that I then need to switch to heat again for the next hair section, but I can’t find a way to toggle back to 76 C as the heat button seems to default back to 50 C. So then I have to press the plus button 26 times again to get the right heat setting and that tedious cycle just continues. This is not a workable product for me. If there actually is a way to toggle between desired temperature and air flow settings and not be resetting constantly, then it’s far too complicated for me to figure out. I don’t like it. 2 stars.

title: Nice Colors & Good Idea But These Extenders Just Fall Off As The Loops Don’t Secure Well
text:
I’ve tried so many brands of masks that loop around my ears trying to find a good fit, but most masks just pop right off my ears and fall off. I don’t know if it’s the shape of my ears, head size or what the issue Is, but a mask extender seemed like a potentially good solution to keep a mask secured in place. Unfortunately, these silicone extenders seem like a poor design that doesn’t help secure a mask in place.

These extenders are only 5.5” long, and each extender has three notches on each side. The idea is to seat the ear loops into the notches to keep the mask on. But the extenders are short and flimsy, and the notches are shallow. The loops don’t securely fit down into the notches in a way where they don’t just separate from the extender. I’ve tried many times and find no way to hook the loops to the notches on the extender so the mask would stay in place. The extender just falls off, and so does the mask.

I’ve tried using these extenders with various brand of masks with stretchy loops, but they don’t work with any of my masks. I don’t know if the extenders could work for a kid or teen or someone with a small head, but I still don’t see how the design of the notches can actually keep the mask loops securely in place. The extenders seem like they need a clip or a way to tie a loop to it or something to secure the loops besides the notches. The variety of colors is nice and I like the idea, but these extenders don’t work for me. 2 stars.

title: Crunch Bar Tastes Pretty Good, Blonde Bar Dominated By Coconut, Dislike Additives Like Sulfites
text:
﻿The variety box has Chocolate Cereal Crunch and Chocolate Peanut Butter Blondie bars. The taste of the Crunch bar is pretty good. It’s a darker brown peanut butter bar with a texture that’s kind of dry with a little crunch from crisp rice. It has a sweetened peanut butter taste with a hint of a chocolate from cocoa. I prefer it to the Blondie bar.

The Blondie bar is a lighter color peanut butter bar with chocolate chips and shredded coconut. The texture is a lot like the Crunch bar but it’s altered by so much shredded coconut (instead of the crisp rice). I like the chocolate chips and peanut taste, but I don’t enjoy the taste or texture of the shredded coconut (just my personal preference). The bars are satiating and filling.

But I’m unimpressed with some ingredients, such as the hydrogenated oils, mono and diglycerides, soy lecithin and caramel color in the Crunch bar and propylene glycol, cellulose gel, soy lecithin and imitation vanilla extract in the Blondie. And I can’t tell from the ingredient list what type (e.g., soy, whey, etc.) of “protein isolate” is in these bars.

I really don’t like that the Blondie bar has sodium metabisulfite. It can cause gastro issues, coughing, wheezing and even shock and life threatening reactions in those with sulfite sensitivity. I just don’t like the additives and these taste processed and have a strange aftertaste. There are protein bars I like better that seem to have cleaner ingredients and are organic. These are just okay. 3 stars. Made in the USA.

title: No Organic Label & No Laxative Effect-Might Help Fatigue & Sore Throat But May Be Coincidence
text:
This is my first time trying Haritaki. I can’t evaluate the purity of this or any other supplement. Notably, the label on my bag doesn’t indicate this is organic and neither does the Herb Essential India site referenced on the bag. The Amazon product page says it is organic and maybe the labeling has changed, but I can only go by the label and must assume (at least for now) this is not organic. I have no way of knowing if this Haritaki is free of contaminants.

Haritaki is supposed to have many potential benefits. The package only refers to it as a “gentle laxative”. It says 3g to 5g can be taken twice daily but doesn’t say if that’s a general dose or for a laxative effect, or how long it should take to work as a laxative. I took two doses the first day and then went to one dose in the morning (each dose was about 5 to 6 grams) for 6 days total. I didn’t have any digestive problems, but this Haritaki didn’t have any laxative effect for me.

Haritaki is extremely bitter (as expected) and is also so astringent it makes my mouth chalky and dry. I can get it down, but I have to mix it with a few ounces of sweet juice even though I don’t normally drink fruit juice. The package didn’t say what to mix the powder with, but I now see on the product page a picture showing to mix it with water. I don’t know if not mixing it in water prevented a laxative effect, but I doubt it as I always drank a full glass of water after taking a dose.

I noticed a few things while taking Haritaki that might be related, or they could just be pure coincidence. The first day, I took it morning and night as directed. That night, I had the most lucid, bizarre, disturbing “dream” (a nightmare actually) that I can recall ever having, and I still remember it as it was so vivid. After that, I didn’t take an evening dose again and started only taking one dose in the mornings. While I understand it may be coincidence, I haven’t had a bad dream again.

I came down with a bad sore throat that felt like the type that would last a few days and drank Haritaki mixed with juice, and my sore throat only lasted the one day. I get really fatigued most afternoons, and I felt more energetic when I took the Haritaki. I’ve since read Haritaki may treat a sore throat and increase energy, but my experience may be coincidence. I can’t fully recommend this product as it’s labeled a laxative but didn’t have that effect on me, and it’s not labeled organic. But it’s possible that it may have some beneficial properties. 3 stars.

title: Good Protection, Good Colors, Coating For Comfort-Run Big, A Bit Bulky, Uncoated Pairs Less Comfy
text:
These household gloves are made of PVC instead of latex and come in a 4-pack that includes 2 green flocklined pairs and 2 white/pink unlined pairs. Each pair is separately sealed. The colors are quite pretty compared to my standard yellow household gloves, and these gloves have cute details like scalloped rims at the opening with dots and little flowers.

These gloves feel thicker and a little bulkier than my usual yellow latex gloves. I do like the feel of the cotton coating inside the two pairs of green gloves as it prevents and/or absorbs sweat and keeps them from feeling clammy or sticky inside. The white/pink unlined gloves don’t feel as comfortable as the PVC does feel sticky to my skin, but they’re ok for short time periods. I’d prefer all the gloves were coated with cotton inside.

These gloves come up higher on my forearms than my similar household gloves, so they offer good protection of my arms and hands from hot or dirty water and grime when I’m washing dishes, cleaning the toilets and so on. The hands have a grippy exterior, so my dishes, wine glasses and other breakables don’t slip through my hands as easily.

These gloves seem to run big. I normally wear a size L in household gloves, but the size L are roomy everywhere. I can and do still use them, but my dexterity isn’t quite as good, they slip down almost off my fingers and the arms gape open a bit much. I’ve reused both styles of gloves and haven’t had any issues of tearing, and I find these easy to get on and off. While not perfect, I like these household gloves for chores pretty well (especially the coated pairs). 3.5 stars.
