title: I use for my nail art
text:
I love to do my own nail art, I change my polish and designs every few days. Sometimes it can get messy, especially if I'm stamping, doing water marble or a sponge design. There are many latex options available for nail art but they are expensive and come in a small bottle. I refused to pay that much so I tried to make my own solution by adding school glue to an empty nail polish bottle and adding a touch of water to help thin it out.
The solution I made does work but it takes so long to dry and I can't begin my art until it dries. Once it is dry I have to worry about it getting too wet during some of my painting, like when I sponge the paint on, the glue becomes sticky and starts to transfer to my nail art. When you try to take the glue off, it does not come off with one simple peel, you have to pick at it and scrape.
This huge bottle of latex has been amazing! I just dip my cotton swab in the liquid then paint it on the skin around my nail. It dries in less than 30 seconds! When I am done with my art, I peel up a corner of the latex and it ALL comes off at once and with ease. This is a must if you do your nails as often as I do, it really helps with cleanup.
Another thing it can be used for, besides the obvious making gruesome lesions in halloween, is a fabric glue. Seriously! If you had a pair of jeans rip and you can't get to a sewing machine but you need a quick patch, use this. Put a little on your finger and spread it on the part you wish to glue, hold it in place for 30 seconds. Wait about 2 minutes before wearing and 12 hours before washing the article of clothing.
This is some super handy stuff!

I was given a promotional discount on my purchase of this liquid latex so that I could test and review and provide you with my feedback.

title: Comfortable, thin, great to give added support to the ball of your foot (area at the base of your toes)
text:
Comfortable added support to area of foot at the base of my toes. These are great soft thin silicon foot cushions. They say gel but to me they are more of just a soft silicon type material. When I think of 'gel' I think of something more fluid filled but these are not filled with anything. By just looking at them you will think they are to thin to do much but the added cushioning they give is pretty remarkable.
Pros: Thin so they don't make your shoes fit any tighter. Soft and gives your added cushion on the bottom of your feet where most of the pressure goes when taking that step forward and bending your toes (base of your toe area). Easy to wash and just allow them to dry overnight to keep them clean. They stay in place and don't slide around, its like they mold to your foot.
Cons: Keeping them flat when putting your sock over them (the edges want to curl so you have to flatten them out after your sock is at least covering them. Although they had not moved, by the end of a 12 hour day of being on my feet on a concrete floor they were feeling like they were cutting into my toes (they hadn't moved and there were no marks on my toes so there wasn't really an issue, it was just I was feeling something in my shoes and after 12 hours, it was really starting to bother me). It kept that part of my foot more moist where my socks had pulled moisture away from other areas, not sure if that will be a problem long term or if just something to stay aware of so I can keep a closer watch on for skin care. Taking my shoes and socks off as soon as I get home and letting my feet "breath" is probably a good habit to get into anyway.

I did receive these at a discount for leaving an honest review and I would not hesitate to recommend them, in fact I have already recommended them to a friend who is having some diabetic foot problems in the area that these offering padding to and I think they will be a great option to improve her foot care.
My only suggestions is that you start out wearing them for shorter amounts of time to get use to them and to make sure you keep them flat when putting your socks on over top of them.

title: A good idea... but...
text:
First things first, this is a fine idea to help sanitize the home automatically by exposing the air from your HVAC system to intense infrared light. My preliminary impression is that it seems to work. To be honest, it would take a year's worth of tracking common colds and other ailments to be able to state that categorically. But after a few short weeks, that seems to be the case.

Now then, here's the "but".

Installation of this device proved to be problematic for a number of reasons. First off, the template that is provided is too small! Note the picture of the template that I cut in half and then added a spacer piece of paper to get the correct distance between the light tubes. Then there was the issue of the tubes being longer than my venting was wide. Okay, I was able to get around that by using a couple 3/4 inch shelf board as a spacer (note the other picture). Finally, there was the minor issue of the keyhole slots in the unit. They "should" suggest that you can place the unit over the screws, then slide it to the side to keep it in place. You can't! The screws provided are larger than the largest part of the keyhole.

I'm not trying to be negative here, as I have the impression that whomever came up with the concept and design of this product was spot on. However, that said, the person (or team) that prepared and packaged it for sale clearly dropped the ball.

title: Now this is the way a selfie stick should work!
text:
Yeah, yeah, yeah... selfie stick... stick your phone on it and take a picture of yourself. What's to get excited about? The answer is... a lot!

First off, there are no wires to connect, it interacts with your phone via Bluetooth. Just place the phone in the holder, pair it up (and it pairs up very easily) and you're off to the races, or the photo lab. No clumsy fumbling around with connections.

But two factors make this a cut above the rest... at least in my experience. First, there is the tripod feature. That's awfully nice to have, especially if you don't want to have to hold the darn thing all the way through a kids gymnastic performance. And then there is the remote control. Just slid out the Bluetooth control button, stay with in range and you can trigger your phone camera to your heart's content. Group selfies? No Problem. A shot of you looking wistfully across the vast landscape? Easy!

This is cool technology!

text:
I've been taking COQ-10 for a few months, and I can't swear that I feel any differently physically, but mentally I feel like I'm taking better care of myself, so that counts for something!

My doctor actually recommended that I start taking COQ-10, and she's a very wise lady, so I usually do what she says. The brand I've been taking are much, much bigger capsules than these, but that's because they're 300mg, whereas these are 100mg. I don't know if I prefer taking one huge pill, or three smaller ones, but for those who prefer smaller things to swallow, these will be preferable.

I haven't experienced any negative side effects from these. I'm taking two at a time, twice a day with meals.

I was going to dock a star star because there's a label stuck over the most important info on the bottle, so I had to get online to find out how strong these are, and what they're made from, etc. It's particularly annoying because there's a blank space where the label could have been placed without covering up anything. I decided not to give a lower rating, thinking that maybe it wasn't the company that put the label there, so it wasn't fair to dock them for it.

As a product reviewer, I received this product at a discounted price in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. I rely heavily on consumer reviews when I shop, so I never write a review that I don't sincerely stand behind, based strictly on my own personal experience with the product.

title: Excellent food storage containers at a realistic price
text:
I was very happy to receive and use these Solimo (Amazon's) Brand containers!!! They came wrapped (cardboard sleeve) 3 per stack. I put them to use at once-- for storing loose coffee, cookies, plastic-ware, and refrigerated leftovers. They stack perfectly, and certainly should be easy to take to picnics, work, long trips (placing in a box or large carryall is recommended to keep them from shifting or falling)

The 64 ounce size is generous. ALOT can be placed in each container -- and the lid snaps shut firmly, keeping everything inside. Of course, every lid will fit any container here. and everything that is not being used stacks securely in one place.

The price for this set of 18 is similar to the equivalent-sized ZipLoc containers at my local store that is known for its lower prices -- each set of 3 Ziploc Containers went for $3.69. I carefully inspected those Ziploc containers and they were the exact size and "texture" of the 18 Solimo containers I had at home.

The only perceived "weak-point" (and it is a "weak-point" for the ZipLocs as well) could be the corners-- they are more flexible than the rest of the container, which might be (IMHO) to keep the container from cracking at that point, should it fall)

I do not put them in the dishwasher -- I soak them and wash them by hand, dry them thoroughly and stack them for future use. I will check to see if the ones I have stored my coffee in will absorb that smell but it's too early to tell right now. I do not know if they freeze well, ( my little fridge's freezer DOES accept the smaller size storage containers and they Do freeze well, so I can assume this 64 ounce Solimo will freeze well, too) but I would suppose so - just don't drop the frozen container or like everything, it may break. UPDATE1-- it not only freezes well, but it does not stain either. UPDATE2 - One of them (test) went thru the dishwasher and came out just fine.

These containers are BPA-free, have no odor, and can be used in the microwave, with the lid slightly open, to Reheat -- not to cook -- leftovers. I'm very happy with the quality AND the quantity of containers in this 18-container Solimo Food Storage set.

title: Best one I've found so far as a replacement
text:
My previous lightweight toiletry bag made by Rick Steves was a disaster (ripped at the seams), and so for the last few years I've been looking for a good replacement with nylon/polyester material. Well, I purchased this sea to summit toiletry kit in large and debated doing so. I try to minimize anything that I use for traveling and every ounce counts. I'm glad I purchased the large size now as it squishes down and reduces its size if not completely full, so it really doesn't take up much space if you don't fill it up, but its great that its large so if/when you need to bring along more items, like on a car trip you have the room! I'm not sure why people downgrade the included "mirror"? I find it just find. Maybe they didn't peel off the protective coating? Not sure, but it works just fine for me for traveling. Who needs a full size mirror in their carryon? The small plastic hook isn't an issue for me either, like one of the other reviewers indicated, just use a piece of string or old shoe lace to attach it to large poles. I tried using this in my bathroom and found many attachment points including the knobs on cabinets. So, thats a mute point for me. And the hook on the Rick Steves bag was TOO big and made of metal and was definitely pointed out by many reviewers but it wasn't an issue with me, the quality of the bag was my issue. So, if you're looking for a lightweight "durable" toiletry bag, I would highly consider this sea to summit version. And if you're looking to pay less, check back often for used/like new bags in amazon warehouse deals. Mine came with manufacturing packaging and labels and never used.

I would like to add that the large exterior zipper compartment is great for when you need to put a few items that you might need to retrieve while in travel mode without opening the entire bag, like a small bottle of lotion, floss sticks, toothbrush/paste or some wet wipes etc. I really like that feature.

title: Works, But No Better Than Much Cheaper Products
text: I have a slow bathtub drain.  Using some "Drano Max Gel" fixes it & it will drain quickly for five or six showers, then it slows down again.  I decided to try this product, hoping it would do a better job & fix the drain for more than five or six showers.  After pouring half a bottle & waiting two hours, I flushed the drain with hot water as instructed.  The drain was clear & the water drained quickly.  But after five showers, it slowed again - just as it does with "Drano Max Gel."  The issue with the Professor Amos product is not how it works, because it does work.  The issue is that is costs $32.95 for the two bottles that total 64 ounces & it doesn't work any better than the "Drano Max Gel" which costs $10.00 for 80 ounces.  And (like the Professor Amos product) the Drano is safe on metal and plastic pipes.  Why pour money down the drain?

title: The Choice med Ovulation and pregnancy  test package is very conwenient.
text: Trying to get pregnant can be really frustrating and if it isn't working it can be heartbreaking. I can tell you this from experience. Getting pregnant with my first child took three years, a reproductive endocrinologist and surgery for both my husband and myself. Luckily the second child was much easier to come by. I easily got pregnant again but miscarried and have not been able to get pregnant since. Up to this point we have pretty much been guessing when I am ovulating, that is not working this time around. I am hopeful that using ChoiceMMed 50 (LH) Ovulation tests can help us. I used them this month and was able to pinpoint when exactly I ovulated and to know ahead of time that it was going to happen. You see one thing that the doctors never told me when I was trying to conceive my first child is that sperm can live up to four days inside of a woman. What that means is that you want to be having sex in the days before you ovulate as well as when you ovulate. By using the ChoiceMMed 50 (LH) Ovulation tests you can tell when your body is ramping up to ovulate. Because an egg is usually only viable for 12 to 24 hours it is not the worst idea to have some sperm waiting for it. Even if you know when you are going to ovulate it is sometimes hard to have sex in that small window of time but if you use the ChoiceMMed 50 (LH) Ovulation tests it should be easy to have sex a day or two before just in case you miss that small window of time. So here is my hint for using the ChoiceMMed 50 (LH) Ovulation tests, in the days leading up to ovulation you should try to have sex once or twice just to improve your chances of getting pregnant. It is nice that this package includes ten pregnancy tests. You are obviously going to need a pregnancy test to find out if your efforts  worked. It is just convenient to have the pregnancy tests included with the ovulation tests. One thing I want to say about pregnancy tests in general is that false negatives are much more common than false positives and with a pregnancy test even a faint line is usually a positive. Each woman and each pregnancy are different. Personally Early testing does not work for me. I have to actually be late to get a positive result on any pregnancy test. With all of my pregnancies I believe I had false negative results  before I had positive results. If you get a negative but not your period just test again in a couple days, you just might get a nice surprise. **DISCLAIMER** I received this product free or at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. My opinions are mine and mine alone and are in no way influenced by the discount. I am an Amazon shopper too and I know how important quality reviews are in the shopping process and decision making. I only review products that I personally need and want to try and I make it a point to share my experiences with the product both positive and negative. Hopefully this review has been informative and entertaining. Feel free to comment positive or negative and let me know if this review has been helpful.

title: A product that needs improvement
text:
My neighbor has hearing problems so when he listens to the TV, he blasts the family room so badly that his wife has to leave and seek shelter in the kitchen. After church a few weeks ago, she was telling me and my wife about the problem and I told her that I thought this product could help. I said I would evaluate it for her and let her know if I thought it would solve the problem.

Unlike my normal approach to electronic gadget installation, I read the manual from cover to cover. The installation seemed easy enough so you can imagine my surprise and disappointment when no matter how I tried, I could not get the hand held unit to sync up with the base. The green lights blinked on both ends and never went solid, steady green. I guessed that the battery wasn't charged so I left it in the base overnight and tried again the next day. Unfortunately, the results were the same. I must have fussed with it for an hour before I gave up. Next, I connected it to my iPhone and tried sound tests with the sound modifier in place and out of the loop. I tried music, voice (audio book) and phone calls. The sound was almost the same with the unit in place and as it was with the unit removed. In fact, I think the sound was a little better without the VitaSound enhancer in place - a little clearer with better dynamic range. The only thing that worked was the white-noise-like button. Kind of useless but there it is...

I could just have a malfunctioning unit. I could be doing something completely wrong (although I doubt it). In either case, I can't recommend this product and it will probably sit in a drawer until I remember to either try it again or toss it out..

Interesting idea, poor execution.

Review for Purple Seat Cushion (Royal).

I really wanted to like this seat cushion, and I was actually planning to buy this seat cushion BEFORE buying a Purple mattress and to only buy the mattress if I liked the cushion. I'm very glad that I just bought everything at the same time, because I did NOT like this cushion, even though I GREATLY like the mattress and pillow! The problem with this cushion for me is that there is no real "form" for your bottom, and so the grid just kind of collapses however and moves around, often making me sit lop-sided. This cushion was hurting my back even more, instead of relieving pain.

I also bought a [[ASIN:B014F18ZGU ComfiLife Gel Enhanced Seat Cushion - Non-Slip Orthopedic Memory Foam Coccyx Cushion for Tailbone Pain - Office Chair Car Seat Cushion - Back Pain & Sciatica Relief]]. I planned to use the Purple seat cushion at my desk and the ComfiLife seat cushion in my car (because it gets hot here and Purple warns about their cushion not being able to withstand high heat). Sadly, the Purple cushion had to be returned, but the good news is that the ComfiLife is working just fine.

Just a note here: don't allow this cushion to influence your decision for the worse when it comes to buying the Purple mattress and pillow. I really, really, REALLY like the Purple mattress and the Purple pillow (I like the pillow even more than the mattress).

title: For sensitive skin
text:
Soft, soft, soft! Contains solid waste as intended. Granted these are not as long as the Grovia[[ASIN:B003TVAPGG Grovia Bio Liner Diaper Liners]] but they are a bit wider and whisper soft. They are about a half inch shorter than the Grovia. Once the baby is on solids or on formula, liners should be used to make solid waste just lift off the diaper and be flushed away neatly. My baby is on solids now and we've been using these for three months. When my Real Nappies ran out I decided to try a roll of the aforementioned Grovia. The Grovia seem scratchier and she got a lot of redness from them. These are made from something different because they will hold up to multiple washes whereas the Grovia looks very linty and wadded after one wash. If your baby has no solid waste and you want to save a little money then just wash them with your cloth diapers. I let them air dry and they're dry in about an hour without hanging them. They flush well even in an iffy system. Since switching back to Real Nappies, her redness is completely gone. Grovia were irritating to her sensitive skin.

Real Nappies does not come with a cardboard tube. Minimal packaging. I will not switch again.

As of May 5th, 2012, I've changed to [[ASIN:B0036QV93C CuteyBaby 6 Pack Biodegradable Diaper Liners]]. They are as soft as the original Real Nappies and not as wide.

title: I didn't find the Royal Purple very comfortable
text:
I ordered the Royal Purple seat cushion as I spend a considerable amount of time at the computer writing. The Royal Purple came right on time two days after I ordered it. I was impressed with the packaging and with my first look at the product. I was astonished at how heavy this cushion is! I think that's a good thing as the weight helps keep the cushion positioned so it doesn't slide around under your bottom. The cushion comes with a protective "pillow case" that appears to be a quality product. The pillow case has a built-in handle making it easy to carry, and the bottom of the pillow case is textured to reduce sliding on your chair. The pillow case combined with the weight of the cushion make it seem like it's fastened securely to the chair. It doesn't move. THAT is awesome!

However, I don't find the cushion to be comfortable. While the cushion is "squishy" when you squeeze it in your hand, it feels firm and stiff under your bottom. As I'm sitting on it while I write this, I feel an uncomfortable edge under my thighs. I find that I quickly grow tired of sitting on it. I'm sad about this as I really wanted this to be the solution to give me comfort as I spend hours at my computer writing. Unfortunately, it's a constant distraction as my thighs feel the edge in a very noticeable way. I think if the manufacturer would taper the front edge of the cushion it might help it some. (Incidentally, I tried the cushion on three different kinds of office chairs and had the same experience.)

title: Amazing shine, Ok cleaner, great polish, so-so durability
text:
FK215 is an all in one cleaner, polish and sealant. As with any all in one, there are compromises. The biggest with FK215 is the durability. Water beading falls of sharply after about 6-8 weeks. If you chase with FK1000P, this is a great product, but if you leave it alone, you will be disappointed.

Pros:
-Great diminishing abrasive polishing action, good enough to tackle minor swirling, even on harder paint. Finishes out very nice too.
-Fair chemical cleaning action
-Amazing shine, looks like another layer of clear coat was applied, very deep and reflective
-Very easy to use
-No fillers, what you see is what you get, it won't look worse after a rain/wash

Cons:
-While you could use it by hand, you will get best results using a random orbital polisher with a white polishing pad. For hand use, there are much better products, ColorX or Duragloss 101 come to mind
-Not very durable, water beading stops within a month or so

After reading my review here, on paper it looks like this isn't a great product. What does shine is the results. If you want quick results with minimal effort, this is a great AIO (All in One). However machine use is a necessity and durability is rather poor.

title: A moderate sexual enhancer for some people... possibly greater dose than label claims
text:
OK, so the most common use for this chemical is to enhance sexual arousal, erections and penile sensitivity in men. In my experience, this does exactly that and in addition makes the user extremely hungry about an hour or more after use. You never really know what goes into herbal "medicines" so I suppose the stuff could contain pot (THC). But I don't get other THC effects such as giggling and laughing or a high so probably not.

What is more concerning is that Yohimbine can have negative, even dangerous side (adverse) effects, especially in older people. You can check these out on the internet, especially in "Google Scholar" articles. And this preparation may contain more Yohimbine than the label says. At least my bottle seemed to. I compared the effects to a pharmacy-provided tablet which was drug grade and pure. The drug grade stuff seemed less potent. Of course that is subjective. I had no way to actually measure the pure Yohimbine content.

I recommend being cautious and only take part of a capsule (you can pour some of the powder out) until you find out how the particular bottle you got affects you personally. As always, buyer beware.

But bottom line: this really is a sexual enhancer for men. In the same sense and probably very similarly to what marijuana/THC does. It works amazingly for that purpose for me. Not sure about how it is for women. Not even sure about how it works on other men! But true sexual enhancers are rare... so be careful but enjoy!

title: Cleaning Isn't All That Fast
text:
The razor has eight floating rotating cutting heads and comes with a box full of attachments and a USB charging cord. Mine came already charged with the full 90 minutes of battery power.

The cutting head pulls off easily and allow the attachments to replace it on the base. Most of the attachments snap on directly except for the nylon facial cleaning brush (with plastic cover) and the rubbery massage brush which need to be attached to an adapter first.

The cutting heads on the outside snap open for cleaning (pretty fast but it has to be done 7 times over) but the central cutting head must be twisted open to clean it which isn't all that easy unless you have very small fingers. Once open you can brush it clean or rinse it.

The cutting heads were just okay at cutting a thick beard, but would be much better at cutting the thinner hair on the scalp. For someone wishing to shave their head it would be ideal - the flexible heads would follow the contours of a head well.

Most of the attachments didn't impress my husband but he did like the nose/ear trimmer attachment. It cuts well and the base provides plenty of oomph to power it. It looks like it would be too bulky to properly position but it was surprisingly easy to use.

I did get a laugh from the label on the top of the box - "Automatic grinding tool head".

Overall, an okay razor set that would be good for someone wanting to shave their head or someone with a lighter beard. If you get five o'clock shadow by 9 a.m. this might not be quite right for you.

title: A Good but not great olive oil
text:
===
Disclaimer: I am not affiliated with the manufacturer and always write from my true experience. But please note that I received this item for free in exchange for my honest review.
===
Review begins:

And let me explain why I say this.
\
1. It is a lighter color and taste than any other EVOO I have bought in the past. The taste is light and fruity, but it is not, in my opinion, what an Extra Virgin Olive Oil (or EVOO) should be like. I have used it on salad, to dip bread in, and in sauces and it just does not impress me, not for the price.

2. It is packaged in plastic. HDPE #2, but still plastic. What is the sense of having sustainable olives used to make this, and then package it in something that will end up in a landfill for 10,000 years? HDPE #2 is recyclable, but on average, only 35% of it gets recycled in the USA. I decanted mine to a green glass bottle with a pourer.

#3 You really should consider decanting this to another bottle. If you pour it out of this bottle, it has a tendency to slop.

#4. This really seems more like a pure olive oil, or this was a 2nd pressing, not a 1st pressing. Granted, this was sourced from Italy and then bottled in the USA and it may have lost something in the shipping, but I honestly do not think this was 1st pressing. For one, it does not indicate that and two, it seems too light to be 1st Pressing EVOO.

#5 For the amount and quality, the price seems too high. This is 16 ounces or 1 fluid pint.

So all in all, while I still give it 4 stars, I will be glad when it is finished up, and we go back to what we have been using. Sorry guys, but this is NOT a top Extra Virgin Olive Oil, in my opinion.

End of Review

title: The Last Trimmer You Will Ever Buy
text:
This just may very well be the best trimmer ever devised by man. I kid you not. It works extremely well, doesn't require batteries, is solidly built and is super easy to clean (simply loosen a set screw and slide the trimmer shaft out the back and rinse). We're talking this thing is built like a tank. It has a nice heavy, sturdy and substantial feel for the size of it. The cutting head is very well done and probably will never need sharpening.

I've had two battery powered trimmers in the past few year, all top rated products on Amazon and none of them even come close in how well this trimmer works and definitely no where close to the quality. The battery powered ones all typically have these plastic components and small spring loaded blades in their trimmer heads which don't last long. Also, typically they are all powered by a single AA battery which has a short lifespan and typically can barely get the trimmer head rotating. No such issues with this device, no plastic, the heavy shaft of the trimmer doesn't have any small parts, just an approximately 1/4" in diameter rod with cuts that serve as blades in the end (a marvel of engineering - simple but super effective) that rotates as you pinch together the ends of the trimmer with your fingers. I was a bit skeptical when I ordered it, but believe me, order this instead of that battery powered device that will be going in to the landfill in a few months. It'll be the best decision you made in months. They could easily offer a lifetime warranty since this thing will never break, its that well made.

title: Not a miracle pill for kidney disease in cats.
text: My holistic vet recommends this.  I am Chinese, and I have faith in Chinese medicine.  More importantly, I can read things about this medicine written in Chinese.  The formula has been out there for many years for humans.  You need to know there are two versions of this med: Rehmannia six and eight.  Rehmannia six is for pets who easily overheat.  Rehmannia eight has two more ingredients than Rehmannia six and is good for pets who tend to seek warmer areas to sleep (which means they prone to get cold).  Anyway, my cat didn't get any better in terms of blood work.  In fact, all the kidney numbers like Bun and Crea went way up by A LOT.  In the meanwhile,  my cat has been under fluid therapy and this med, so Rehmannia Eight really didn't help at all to bring my cat's kidney's number down.  I don't know how to feel about this med - it didn't make anything worse, nor did it help.  Maybe try it for a month and get your pet a blood test for final decision.

title: Fouth favorite case I've tried for the t:slim X2.
text:
I've tried four different cases for the t:slim X2.

The t-case that came with the pump was mediocre The clip didn't reliably hold it on my web belts whether used in the vertical or horizontal orientation. When I tried sleeping with the pump at night in a t-shirt pocket the clip dug into me. The t:case is very strong, hard and unyielding. It's my second choice.

Note: All these followig cases, whether branded in the molds or not, are manufacted by other companies, mostly in China, and sold under many names. The US sellers are distributors and dealers.

The next case I tried was this one. It had no clip. It had to be removed to change cartridges; the opening for the cartridge was too small and there was no slot to insert the removal card into to pry the cartridge loose. It's not difficult to do but that reoeated stress 122x/year imo will impact its life.

This case is okay if you are willing to carry it in a pocket, remove it every 2-3 days for a cartridge change and attach a suitable clip to it. That was too many compomises for me. So this is my fourth choice.

I contacted the seller who told me it was an older model. I couldn't exchange it for the new model; they didnt list in the color I wanted in their Amazon listing. So I returned it. The newer model is currently sold by another seller as item B09KCRNCY3. This one doesn't protect the pump a well as the t:case does without its beltclip. It's better than the t:case bare, but since a clip costs $5-8 and installation, not as good as the OEM. So it's my third choice.

My current first choice is almost the same as my third choice but covers much more of the face. It's being sold now as B09L2CY5Q3. I attached a clip to it and have worn it for 4 months, day and night. It is simillar to the Medmax case B09PN979K4, but lighter, without the corner bumpers.

If the case I'm using doesn't outlive my pump, and i can't get the same one again, the Medmax would be my next chiose.

It’s so strong I could smell it through the Prime Pantry box. I ended up getting these in a Prime Pantry box with a promotional whearas I only had to pay for shipping, so it was a pretty good deal for me.

As a matter of fact, my car was starting to smell a little funky because I don’t clean it out as much as I should, so all I did was keep this closed box in there for a few days and whatever was smelling weird in my car, apparently seceded to be with the flowers.

That being said, yes the smell dulls down eventually… But not really until you use a dryer sheet in the dryer. I haven’t noticed this product being any more fragrant than other dryer sheets after the fact. It fades, just like they all do. I haven't noticed it really affecting my clothes' soft feel, either. But then again, I've never really found this to be true with any dryer sheets I use. I usually cut these in half and use them half at a time because I tend to have smaller loads. Honestly, one of these packages usually lasts me like a year and a half, maybe a little less if I use them to de-staticify myself.

title: 3% Hydrogen Peroxide Has Many Uses
text:
Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2)rts hydrogen and 2 parts oxygen. What makes it so special is the oxgen. When it comes in contact with organic compounds (anything with carbon in it), it will release oxygen, thereby oxygenating the substance. Most of us know that H2O2 is a good disinfectant, and this is because it oxidizes the bacterial germs, killing them or rendering them harmless. Thus, H2O2 makes a very good skin disinfectant, makes a good mouthwash, will disinfect toothbrushes, cutting boards, sink basins, etc. It is great for getting blood out of clothing, and works on other organic stains as well. It deoderizes anything it comes in contact with. As a dentist, I have prescribed this for patients with gum disease 3-4 rinses with flossing each day. Gum disease organisms die in the presence of H2O2. It can be scrubbed on the tongue to eliminate tongue discoloration and odor.

In contrast to chlorine bleach, H2O2 is non-corrosive, can be used on the body, and is not harmful to septic tanks as well. I am sure there are many hundreds of uses for this simple compound. Best of all, it is cheap. Most stores have this size bottle for about a dollar or less.

Have a bottole on hand for when the kids tip their kool-aid on the carpet. H2O2 works about as well as anything on that.

title: May be not 100%, but it works, although not durable product or effect
text:
I have to agree and disagree with some of the critical reviews.

First, does it work ? in one word YES, But...

As other customers mentioned, although this is my first time to use glass file, I am happily surprised that it actually works very very well.
The buffering blocks. I haven't used the small one yet to see if it is hard to use like some customers reported or not yet, but I thought I will keep that one for traveling and use the big one for home.

Yes, except for may be the Extra coarse and coarse grit, it feels as if all buffers sides are dull, which is not necessarily a bad thing, compared to the extremely harsh snapper blocks with one sided open foam, which I received from another company, which one can use to sand wood because it would be even harsh for your car paint !!, but despite how they feel, they actually worked, and although my nails were not terrible to start with, but now they look and feel the smoothest and shiniest they have ever been, so I don't really care if they feel the same grit or not and if they all feel dull, but here are the issues I have so far

1- My biggest problem so far, is durability, I don't think these are durable at all, and at such price, I will consider them extremely expensive, if they last not even a month or two. I only had them for couple of days and yes I had to use them 4-5 times to achieve the results, but some of the grit plates are actually slowly coming apart and threats are coming from the undersurface where they are glued to the foam block, so I highly doubt that they will last beyond 2 month. If these were $2 that might have been ok, but at almost $11, I would say minimum of 6 mo, is what I would consider reasonable

2- They actually leave extremely fine scratch, which is not truly visible unless you look side ways under direct light, but may be that is what leads to number 3 :-)

3- As beautiful and shiny the nails look immediately after you are done, as if just walked out of fine, high end salon, unfortunately most of that goes away with the first hand wash , even if you don't use soap, which is very disappointing, even for someone like me, who used to hate shiny nails for men !!

4- I really didn't like/appreciate the fact that the company immediately dropped the price $2-3 after my purchase !

I will try to post photos shortly

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

An update 03/26/2017 --- will change from 2 to 4 stars for now, and may change to 5, if it survive the first 6 months :-)

First, my disclaimer. The company contacted my simultaneously at the same time I was posting me review, to ask me about my feedback, so I told them that I just finished reviewing it, they emailed me back and were extremely nice about it, apologizing that I wasn't happy with their product, I asked them if they can at least partially refund me, to price match the current price, which if they didn't I would have likely returned the product. To my surprise they told me that they decided to issue me a full refund, which I felt terrible about, because that was never my intention, because I really loved the glass file, and the buffers work , but had the issues that I mentioned, So I thought this would be unfair to them, so I wrote back to tell them that and ask them to just to do a price match (- $2-3), or send me another set and that will take care of it, but they said full refund was already issued and they actually did and I already received it. I said this upfront, before I update the product review, because I know what people will think, but honest to God this experience while reflected very highly on the company and their customer service, but by no means, shape or form affected my update for the product review and that is why I am keeping the original, so you can judge for yourself.

1- Durability - Still a concern and I guess only time will tell, So I may have to update this few months from now :-)

2- After reading their entire add on amazon website, I realized later on , that I MAY have used some of the harsh buffer sides slightly more than I should have and that may have led to these fine scratch that the shining buffer, couldn't hide any more, but after experimenting a little, I think I almost got rid of most of them, and the remains are really negligible.

3- Longer lasting shine - This may have ben also my mistake ! - I don't really like shiny nails for men, but when I tried it out of curiosity, I immediately stopped buffing them the second they became shiny, and when I did that, that shine would go away with the first hand wash, but for whatever reason, I guess with repeated buffing using only the shinning side, I ended up with nice, very smooth shine, that actually doesn't go away with washing, showering etc, despite doing it multiple times now, and all of a sudden I start liking shiny nails, even for me!, something I never ever thought that I will be ok with!, at least for myself, now I ended up doing my toe nails too and they look the best they ever did in my life ! :-)

So all the above, in addition to excellent customer service experience, not only that have led me to update the review, but I ordered 2 more sets, one as back up for me and the other as gift for my wife, who I hope will like as much as I did, instead of using toxic ugly nail polishes.

I will knock back and energy shot on occasion, but I typically struggle to get the whole thing down because they taste is not always great and it take me a few gulps to finish.
These little spray bottles offer an interesting alternative to that.

Instead of drinking from a tiny bottle, you this directly into your mouth.
That is an ideal delivery system because you can easily adjust how much you want to consume once you figure out how it affects you.
It's also compact and super portable.
On paper, it's a win win win.

That of course begs the question of why I did not give it a full five stars...
Well, it mostly comes down to the taste, which I did not enjoy.
Basically, after taking this, I immediately need to drink something to wash the flavor out of my mouth.
Individual palettes vary widely, so I can't say what I do not care for might not be someone else's cup of tea.
To find out how you feel about the sour flavors, you really do need to try them for yourself.

I also thought the effect was not the same as other energy boosting products.
This gave me I drank too much coffee feel, so effective, but not quite what I was hoping for.
Still, like tastebuds, responses to the ingredients in this sour spray will probably vary as well.

In the end, I would recommend trying this flavored, caffeine enhanced, breath spray if you are looking for an energy booster that is compact, convenient, and simple to customize when it comes to how much you take.

title: Snuggly soft and super warm
text:
This is a great heated throw/blanket.
For me, it arrived at the perfect time, as our temperatures dipped significantly the night it arrived.
Consequently, I pulled this out of it box and popped it onto my bed first chance I get.

Size-wise, I would consider this a one person blanket/throw.
If you turned it sideways, you could snuggle under it with a partner, but I think the best way to take advantage of it would be to selfishly keep it all to yourself. 😁

The fabric is a very soft fleece in a camel color.
It's extra appealing, particularly since other heated throws I had were much scratchier.
This one is genuinely extra appealing to use, even when the heat is off.

The controls for this blanket are quite simple and straightforward.
The power button (larger one in photo) works on a slide, so you are not likely to unintentionally turn this on.
The heat level works on a push button that you just click until the one of three available options you prefer is illuminated.
The automatic shut off for the heat kicks in after two hours, so this is not an all night heated throw/blanket, unless you want to wake up to turn it back on throughout the night.
This does, however, work very well as a lap blanket or as a way to quickly heat up your bed before you crawl in.

The range of heat is hard to describe, but I would describe it as going from just noticeably warm to hot, but not uncomfortable.
This does not get at hot as a heating pad, but the top setting is still pretty toasty.

When it comes time to wash this, the cord disconnects easily.
I included a photo of the washing instructions, which include both hand and machine options depending on your preference.

The cord on this is nice and long, but whether it will work for you obviously depends a lot on where you want to use it and how close it is to an outlet.

Overall, I am thrilled with this heated throw/blanket.
This is an ideal way for staying warm in a cold room.
It would be an absolutely perfect gift for someone who always complains about being cold when they are seated.
I am completely thrilled with the texture, appearance, and function of this heated throw/blanket and would recommend it as an excellent value.

title: Melatonin with extras
text:
This is a 30 to 60 day supply of sleep aid, depending on how much melatonin you prefer to take.
While the recommended dose is two capsules, which is 10 mg of melatonin, I know some people prefer smaller doses of melatonin, so you do have the option of a half dose.

The capsules are made in the USA at an FDA approved facility, so you can feel comfortable taking them.
I also like that the manufacturer provides all the label information on the product page, which give you the opportunity to review all the detail for yourself when deciding if this is the right supplement for you.

When taking these myself, they don't make me drowsy as much as they help me sleep more deeply.
That being said, if you know how you react to melatonin and the other ingredients, you might expect a different reaction.
If you have never tried a sleep aid before, this would be a pretty good one to start with.
It's all natural and you could start with a half dose to see how you respond to the formula before increasing to the full dose.
Better yet, you'll get some extra vitamins as a side benefit.

Based on my experience and my review of the nutritional details, I would definitely recommend this supplement.
It will very likely enhance your sleep in some way, as well as giving you a day's worth of B6 vitamin, which for me is a win-win.

title: Nicey, but pricey
text:
These collagen supplements are easy to take, arrived with a fresh by date in 2023, and include some vitamin C, selenium, and vitamin D.
Unfortunately, I can't tell you how much selenium or vitamin D each recommended dosage of 2 pills per day contains because those details are not provided.

Overall, I like this collagen supplement and have experienced no negative side effects taking it
The only real reservation I have is that you only get a 28 day supply and it is quite pricey.
At the current price of $41 a bottle, that come out to ~$1.46 per 2 tablets/day or $43.80 for a 30 day/month's supply.
I tried to include legible photos of the labels showing the ingredients and nutritional details so that you could assess for yourself if this particular supplement provides enough of the right kind of collagen for you to invest in.

As a big believer in collagen as an important supplement to take, I would recommend these as easy to swallow and incorporate into a daily routine.
Since collagen supplements tend to be expensive in general, this might be the right fit for your diet and your budget.

title: Effective and comfortable
text:
This is the most cushiony sleep masks I've tried, so I was curious as to how all the extra cushion would impact using the mask.
Honestly, it doesn't make much difference.

Sleeping with this on blocks out all light, so you can sleep well, even in a very brightly lit room.
That makes it perfect for people who have to sleep during the day or those who are sensitive to even small sources of light, which are hard to avoid due to the proliferation of electronics in our homes.

Comfort wise, I would also give this high marks.
The mask did not impede my sleeping much, which is saying something because I am a fitful sleeper, prone to insomnia.
While I did push the mask around as I tossed and turned, it continued to block out light and did not shift much or irritate my skin.
Most importantly, this mask does not impede your ability to breathe through your nose or press on your eyes.

I would also give this mask very high ratings on materials and construction.
While time and use alone will reveal its durability, I have a good feeling based on the way it is made that this sleep mask will hold up for a good long time.

The only negative aspect of this sleep mask is the same design flaw I find with 99% of the sleep masks on the market, namely the velcro closure at the back.
While the closure is easy enough to use and adjust, if you have long hair like me, it inevitably gets caught in the velcro hooks, which in turn tears a few strands out.
The workaround I have found for this issue is to set the strap of the mask to the point where it is most comfortable for me, then wrap the exposed velcro hooks with yarn to prevent them from tearing at my hair.
While I am tempted to take a star off for this issue, I know it does not effect everyone and I am resigning myself to the fact that it is a feature of the vast majority of sleep masks.
Basically, it's just something people with longer hair kind of have to live with.

If you are looking for a very high quality mask, I would recommend this one.
It is very effective at blocking light and very comfortable to wear during sleep.

title: Lovely fragrances and presentation, but not as powerful as I hoped
text:
These little discs smell delightful... In the box.
They have such nice fragrances that I have put them in my linen closet, where they are making my towels and sheets smell wonderful.
Where these fall down is in the shower, where I found their effect underwhelming.

To use these you simply unwrap one disc, then set it just beyond the direct stream of your showerhead; basically, put it in the splash zone.
The disc will then gradually dissolve, releasing a very subtle fragrance as it does.
The trouble is that, at least in my case, the scent of the discs is easily overpowered by all the other products I use in the shower.
Unless I bend down to sniff the disc, the fragrances of my shampoo, conditioner, and body wash are all I really pick up on.

In fairness to these discs, my shower is over an old cast iron tub with a double shower curtain, so it is possible that in a smaller shower with a glass door these might have more of an impact.
I also tried two fruity fragrances first, so some of the other scents might also might pack more of a punch.
In the past, I used similar products made with menthol and eucalyptus that were meant to help reduce congestion that were very powerful, so that might also make these seem less fragrant by comparison.

In the end, I suspect these would be better used as bath bombs, but overall they are not bad.
These discs smell wonderful and come in a beautiful box that would make them ideal for gifting.
They could be a sweet hostess gift or a nice addition to a bath/spa themed gift basket.

title: I really wanted it to work..
text:
I ordered this sheet after listening to Clint Ober on a teleseminar.. I did some research and decided it made very good sense. I still think it makes sense, but I can't honestly say the sheet has made any difference in my overall health or sleep patterns. I totally feel that I have wasted a lot of money.
I do go barefoot most of the time (since I work from home I can do that).. So I'm walking on the ground all the time barefoot in warmer months. However, living in northern Michigan, there are many months when that isn't possible. I really thought this sheet would help the most during those winter months..
I purchased it last fall, slept on it all winter, but honestly, it doesn't seem to have done a single thing for me. I tested my outlets with the tester provided to make sure we have proper grounding, and we do, but just can't say I felt any difference. In fact, I took it off my bed about 6 weeks ago and forgot about it until I just received a notice for a teleseminar with Clint Ober as a guest. That's when I realized I hadn't even slept with this sheet for weeks and hadn't noticed any difference at all.
I did contact Clint Ober about this and said that I didn't feel it was doing any thing for me. He asked if I had washed it with bleach or harsh detergents, which I hadn't. He asked if I'd used fabric softener on it, and I had, once, because the directions don't actually warn you not to do so (or at least the ones I received didn't. I found out by listening to another teleseminar he was on)..He said using softener on it once shouldn't hurt it at all. He said I should check to make sure it's connected correctly. It's hooked up the only way it can be, so I assume yes it is. He said I should probably have it checked to make sure it's working.. But other than the tester sent with the sheet to check your outlet, I have no idea how one goes about testing the sheet itself to make sure it's working????? I did ask about that but never received a reply.
At 57, I have many achy joints, especially in the winter months, which did make me think grounding makes sense. When it's warm out and I'm barefoot most of the time, I do feel less achy.. However, the sheet did not seem to help in that area. I also have thyroid problems...saw no difference. And I developed psorisis on my leg over the winter while using it. Had never had it before in my life...I used other, much less expensive alternative solutions to cure the psorisis, but have to question, if this sheet is so good for us, how did I develope something I'd never had before while using it?
All in all, I think there are a lot of other health alternatives out there that are a lot cheaper that will probably work better for you. I hate to say that, I really do, because I so wanted this to be a wonderful investment... The book does have a lot of good info in it. My advice, buy just the book, then spend as much time as you can walking barefoot outside, even if it's only 15 minutes a day.. It's free, and you'll get more out of it than sleeping on this sheet.

text:
I tried. I really tried to find a way to use this healthy powder in the foods that I eat. But, I could not. I tried this in my morning yogurt with blueberries. Nope, not doing that again. I tried this broccoli powder in some chicken noodle soup.....better, but still nope. Now, I will admit that I may not be using this the correct way and I am probably using too much in the dishes I have tried it in.

I like raw broccoli and eat it whenever it is around. And this powder did taste somewhat like broccoli. But, that taste did not translate into the foods I added this to.

The powder is also extremely fine and it comes in a heavy duty paper bag with a solid 'Ziploc' style closure at the top. I like to push all the air I can out of the bags of this style before closing them. This was a mistake with this fine powder. When I tried to gently extract the air a pretty big dust cloud formed outside the bag. No matter how gentle I was in trying to push the air out a lot of broccoli powder formed an impressive dust cloud. 10 minutes later I went back into the kitchen and could still smell the broccoli powder.

I was hoping to make some of the food I eat healthier with this powder, but I don't think this will work for me. Even with my critiques above, I don't this is a bad product. There are probably other ways to use this broccoli powder successfully. It just won't work for my uses.

title: Works fine but would prefer scent (and bottles are SMALL)!
text:
The thing about this brand is that its products smell A-MA-ZING! They work great, yes, I suppose, but the reason you want them for your laundry is definitely the scent. That's also why you'd want such a small bottle of their products -- to get that amazing scent in each product that you use.

But these are unscented. So they work fine and remove stains if you spray them before washing, but for the life of me, I can't imagine why anyone would want such small bottles of laundry stain remover?? The small size makes them easy to misplace, hard to find a good spot for in the laundry room and not last long enough to get rid of more than a couple of small stains.

Without the favorite scent of the laundry detergent, these stain remover sprays just don't seem worth the trouble of trying to live with such tiny bottles. Four stars because they do remove stains. But would need to be larger bottles and smell good to get five stars from this house.

Maybe these would work for travel, but in that case, I'd think you'd prefer the readily available Tide pens.

title: Great idea -- less waste, perfect for travel!
text:
What a great idea--putting laundry detergent into dryer-sheet sized sheets. I tried these immediately upon receipt and found them to be as good or better than the typical liquid detergent I use. But of course, much lighter and more environmentally friendly.

These would be great for travel-- in case you need to run to a laundry mat in the hotel or nearby while on vacation, but I also think they'd be great for people who regularly use laundry mats or community laundry rooms (dorms, apartment buildings or hotels), who likely get tired of lugging big, heavy bottles around with their laundry.

This option is much lighter, uses no plastic, travels easily and is priced well. I can't think of anyone who wouldn't want to take advantage of all of these benefits.

The only downside is that these haven't been tested against some of the big names, so I don't know how well they actually clean my clothes. I'm someone who prefers to use laundry detergent that has been tested against a wide range of required uses to ensure it is as effective as possible at getting my laundry clean. Until this product is independently tested, I'll likely never trust it with my dirtiest laundry.

The problem for me is, I have thin, shorter, old lady lashes. And I just think heated eyelash curlers don't do as much for us as they do the younger set. That's been my experience anyway. While I like the idea, and might try it with fake lashes, it didn't seem to lift my eyelashes as much as I would have liked (or as much as my trusty Shu Umera version already does) even when I used it AFTER applying mascara, so it's not something I'll use often unfortunately.

title: Well priced, great product, but some unexpected cons
text:
These are a really nice value for the price -- two pill cases and a pill cutter. I liked that these had space for only one set of pills per day and can always use an extra case, so thought they'd be perfect for me. And I can see a lot of instances in which these might work well for someone.

First, unlike most pill containers, there's braille on each day of these so those with vision problems can easily distinguish one day from another. The letters of the week on each slot are very large, so in theory, they're easy to read. I also like that I can carry one smaller row of pills rather than typical cases, which are much larger and made for twice a day pills.

The problem is that the cases aren't see through, so it's hard to know whether or not the days are filled just from glancing at it. I didn't realize how often I glance at the pill case to see if it needs to be refilled. And while the letters ARE large and there's braille to distinguish each day, the letters are the same color as the case itself, which I still find hard to see.

The addition of a pill cutter was just a bonus for me, but these are always nice to have on hand.

title: a life saver
text:
Have a twisted rib. Old injury and one unexpected hard sneeze and there it is again. Took me a long time to figure out what was going on. My arm at my side created too much heat and the 1 ice pack I had available (staying at my Moms) wasn't enough by a long shot. So, I needed more than 1 ice pack (W-M didn't have what I needed) and I needed a way to keep them wrapped around me.

I ordered a 6" Chattanooga Nylatex Wrap and a set of 6x10 gel ice packs. I need them end to end to go around my side. And I needed a way to keep them there. I put them in an old pillow case (20 inches across the bottom), wrap it around the Nylatex Wrap and I can put it on myself and keep the ice packs where I need them.

And a little trick I'll share. Keep the pillow case and Nylatex Wrap in the freezer with the ice packs. Instant cold no waiting. The minutes the ice packs are getting the wrap and pillow case cold are minutes you're missing out.

title: Your weight will be a surprise every time....
text:
Nice slim design but not so much that it feels flimsy or cheap. I love the big display that I can see before my contacts are in in the morning. The problem is it gives you a different weight every time you step on, regardless of whether you wait the 20 seconds for it to reset or not. It wouldn't be a big deal if it was within 1 pound but I've gotten 7-10 lbs variance from 5 seconds later to 5 minutes later. Super frustrating for someone tracking weight loss progress and especially bad for my grandpa who needs to track minute weight fluctuations for a medical issue.

Update (Feb 2017): Finally got rid of this paperweight. Paid a little more for a Taylor scale that's accurate, takes half the batteries to run, is lighter, nicer looking, and doesn't fluctuate 8lbs when you step off and back on 2 seconds later. What a useless scale!

title: Not bad for the price, you get what you pay for.
text:
Okay, I did not buy this through Amazon. I bought it LNIB from Goodwill.

I am on my feet all day at work and average around 5 miles walking a day.

First, disregard the "heat maintenance feature". Nonexistent. The only heat is from the water you add.

Disregard the "acupressure" attachments, they are static and likely only work if you move your feet across them.

But.

I don't agree with the complaints about the bubble production or massage features. Is it like soaking your feet in a hot tub? No. Is it like getting your feet rubbed by a masseuse/masseur? No.

However, I soaked my tired dogs in it for half an hour and while it may only be a step or two up from soaking them in a plastic basin, $I wouldn't complain for $20, let alone what I paid for mine. The bubble feature worked better than expected based on reviews I read and there are raised nodes on the bottom for your arches. The splash guard does its job.

I don't get the no additives thing because there is no plumbing to circulate the water so nothing to develop build up. It's probably just a disclaimer to protect them from liability in case an individual uses something that doesn't help or causes an issue.

I didn't pay retail price for it but would buy it again if I did.

title: Work fine with my Sonicare at a fraction of the cost
text:
These replacement heads work just fine on my Sonicare toothbrush at a fraction of the cost of genuine Philips heads. The tradeoff is that these don't have the RFID chip in them to talk to the toothbrush so the head change reminder on the brush will not work with these heads. These also don't have any wear indicating bristles that loose their dye after ~3 months which is a bit disappointing as head changes are totally up to you to remember. This is fine but would've been a nice to have.

These soft heads are a much gentler and less aggressive head than the Philips heads. I feel like their don't quite clean as well and I tend to trade them out ever 2 months instead to keep them feeling newer and firmer. Still for the price, this is a great value for cheap replacement heads.

text: I like the concept of refills to reduce plastic waste.  These are fairly low cost per refill ($2.99 for 3 at time of review).  There is a lack of direction provided by the packaging.  It does say on the product page that each pack creates 34 oz of cleaner so it is safe to assume you add up to that much in water to get the right concentration.  It dissolves more readily if you use warm water.  The cleaner itself seems to be working as well as other multi-purpose cleaners I have used. There is not much of a scent so if you like a fresh clean smell you may have to augment the recipe.  Overall it works pretty well and is a reasonable cost compared to pre-bottled cleaners.

The lather is good enough and the bristles are fairly soft. The overall style of the brush is good. It does have some quality issues with the varnish showing water spots, which is why I knocked a star off. Overall it is a good brush, that will hopefully will last me a few years.

title: Solid Construction, Doesn't Position Lock
text: The materials are pretty solid.  Assembly is simple but not easy. There are four screws that connect the dowels and base of the foot rest.  These screws go through the side plates into the dowels and become tight and difficult to continue turning.  This is partly because the pilot holes are tight but also because you have to hold the dowel tight to keep it from spinning while tightening.  The top of the rest connects using a bolt and nut combo on each side that serves as the pivot hinge for the flowing top.  Mine came with quite a few extra hardware, but as far as I can tell looking at the one page instructions these are just extra.  The top of the foot rest is free floating and has no way to lock the position.  The massage pieces are made of solid plastic, which can be good in the short term for massaging the feet but not great for long term sitting as a foot rest.  Overall the materials are good, but the design is just okay.  It could use a removable pin to lock the rotation of the top if desired.

title: Easy to use but the instructions could have been better
text:
I stumbled upon this kit and wanted to try it increase blood circulation to my scalp. I am a novice so after carefully reading the instructions, the device was fairly simple to operate but the instructions did not explain which tool is used for what area of your face. Lucky for me, the hair tool is obvious but I had to look at the product description on the Amazon listing to educate myself on the other 3 tools.

The wand handle is a little bulky but inserting the glass tools into it is very easy. The rotary knob to turn device on/off and to control the intensity is located at the base of the wand. The intensity is indicated by a series of dots going from smallest to largest making it a guessing game in determining the level of intensity. Instead, I wish the intensity was labeled by number to better gauge what works best for each user. Perhaps if level 4 didn’t give me good result, i’ll know with some level of certainty that I need to turn it up to level 5 or 6. Again, I am a novice so perhaps this is standard for these kinds of devices.

I have used it a few times and I have enjoyed the experience but I haven’t notice any change in my hair as of yet. Not sure if I should increase the intensity or what intensity I used during my last treatment but i’ll continue to use and monitor my progress. Overall, great device with numerous applications and benefits.

title: Warm and soothing
text:
[[VIDEOID:8965b91328a590c5b87d78bc425d90c0]] This heated eye mask is a fantastic way to soothe your eyes and get some much needed relaxation. This is for dry heat only, something to keep in mind if you need moist heat therapy for your eyes like I do, but I still enjoy this for relaxing while I listen to my audiobook.
The fit is decent, although I do notice that it goes pretty far down on my nose when I line my eyes up with the “holes,” making nose breathing a little awkward while wearing this. It gets a good light seal when lined up properly, but that’s the position that breathing is weird in for me.
The heat is nicely distributed along the edges of the mask as well as over the part that goes over your eyes (the “eye holes”), but for myself I can only feel the heat when this is turned onto its max setting, to me it feels like it should just be an on/off switch because the lower two settings I don’t feel like it’s actually on.
The magnetic power cord attachment is a really cool feature that adds safety in case you fall asleep in it, but also makes attaching the cord very easy if it accidentally comes off while you have the mask on.
Overall I do enjoy this mask for relaxation, but I still have to use moist heat on my severely dry eyes that this cannot provide.

And the fact they felt it necessary to add “All specifications are subject to change without notice.” Yeahh, that’s a red flag for me. Go with another brand!

title: Natalist x Everlywell Women’s Fertility test
text:
I love Everlywell’s tests and I love that they partnered with the Natalist brand for this test. Like Everlywell’s other kits, this comes with everything you will need in Natalist’s sleek hunter green packaging. There’s a registration card, detailed instructions, a lab form, band aids, lancelets, alcohol prep pads, and gauze. The test card and everything else has your kit # on it so nothing can be mixed up. A prepaid return mailer is in the bottom of the box, too.

What does this test for?
LH(Luteinizing Hormone)
FSH(Follicle Stimulating Hormone)
TSH(Thyroid Stimulating Hormone)
Estradiol
Testosterone
All key components that influence your female fertility.

Also what I like about this test that differs from Everlywell’s own tests is the QR code you can scan on the back of the box. It takes you a Natalist webpage which gives you an in-depth look at what roles your hormones play in your fertility health and why it’s important to have them tested.

2 tips: 1; if you’re squeamish about needles I would have your hubby, significant other, or bf help you with the lancelet. Just press down firmly(it’s spring loaded) and one use each. It doesn’t actually hurt I just have issues doing it to myself lol. It’s a small prick, as if you slipped when sewing, easier than having blood drawn by a mile.

2nd tip; make sure you’re well HYDRATED before doing this. You don’t want to go through the process only to find out you don’t have enough blood for the test card. All the little circles must be full.

I recommend this test for any woman who wants to check her reproductive health or is trying to conceive. Or if you suspect you have hormone imbalances, PCOS, or have a hard time getting in to get lab work done. These tests are easy, private, and reliable!

title: Good quality but can feel uncomfortable.
text:
I'm surprised I didn't squirm since I have ticklish feet. This foot massager works very well and comes with a manual and a remote control. The quality is there and I love the red metallic color. Depending on where you place your feet, the pressure it puts on my feet can be a little painful sometimes. Maybe not to others but it would be great if there was a setting to have light and hard pressure.

There are 4 different auto modes and 3 different modes that focus on your toes, arch or sole. There are also 3 speed settings and a direction setting which allows you to choose if you want the massage to focus going forward or backwards. You can only use the speed and direction options if you choose to use the massage in manual mode only. So you can choose to get a auto massage, a massage that focuses on your toes, arch or sole, or manually where you can choose the direction and speed.

The feeling, there is a feeling of a ball placing pressure and rolling under your feet and pads on each side that will place pressure and squeeze your feet, syncing with the movement of the ball that rolls. And I do move my feet around to see how the massager feels like instead of just placing my feet in the same area the whole time, this actually helps a lot when I'm uncomfortable with the pressure and only need part of my foot massaged. My favorite setting so far is "sole".

This massager is big but that doesn't bother me since it's a well made foot massager, and there are handles on each side if you want to pick it up. The cord is short but an extension fixes that. The included manual is simple and easy to understand.

Pros:
- Quality, product is well made.
- Works well.
- Rolling balls under your feet and pads on sides sync during massage.

Cons:
- No pressure setting, can feel uncomfortable.
- Short cord.

This is a very promising product, if there was a pressure setting it would definitley help with feeling more comfortable since everyone has different feet. But now I won't have to ask someone for a foot massage and I'm definitely going to pull this massager out after a long day of walking or if I just feel like lounging around and relaxing.

I received this product at a discount in exchange for an honest and unbiased review. My reviews are my own and are not influenced in any way. I hope my review has been helpful, thanks for reading.

Heat function takes a minute to heat up but once it’s at its max, you can really feel the heat.
The massager has 2 pinpoint speeds, a moderate and an intense one. Both speeds feel really good.
This massager works great for those with bigger size feet. I usually wear a Men’s 9 and the pinpoints were in the perfect spots for me.

Cons:
The air cushion feature of this massager is useless. I’d compare the “compress” feeling it provides your feet to what you’d feel on your arm when getting your blood pressure tested, but not as strong.
This massager is not great for those with smaller feet. My mom is usually a Women’s 6.5 and her toes barely go past the other end of the air cushion sleeve.
Overall the air cushion sleeve fabric did not feel really comfortable to me
I wish there was an option to adjust the length of the pinpoints so that the massager could work for all feet sizes.

title: High-quality brush, soft, nice lather, doesn’t stink…
text:
This is a really nice shaving brush. On arrival it was already nice and soft, compared to some other badger brushes which can sometimes need to be broken in more before getting soft. The handle is made of nice wood, very much resembling the pictures in the item listing. I have uploaded a photo of the brush I received, next to my usual daily brush which I would consider to be of average size, so that you can see that the handle of this one is a little bit longer, and you can see the size of the badger hair plume which is a similar size. The materials all appear to be of high-quality, and it seems well-made. The wood is very smooth. and nicely finished. The handle might be a bit longer than my preference, though that may be because I am used to the other brush I showed in the photo which has a shorter handle.

The brush lathers nicely. The bristles are soft, and only very few of the bristles came out when using this brush, noting that a new brush like this will usually lose a few hairs early on. So this is a positive comment not a negative one, meaning that it lost fewer hairs than some competing brushes.

As badger brushes usually do, it did have a slight musky odor when wet initially. This brush had less of that musky odor than the last new brush I got (not the one in the photo). This brush has just a very slight amount of that odor, which is already almost gone now that I have used it. These badger brushes typically have that scent initially and then it resolves naturally with use, usually within the first couple uses, but that process can be sped up, particularly if you happen to get a brush that has more of that scent. Because that scent is so slight with this brush, which is another positive for this product, I will add some comments here in case you happen to have more of that musky scent with your brush, even if it is a different brand brush than this one, in case this information might be helpful to you. Again this is considered normal and dissipates over time with use. There a number of home remedies meant to speed up the process of getting rid of the odor from a new badger brush… People do any number of the following remedies, sometimes using combinations of them. These remedies include mixing a spoonful of Borax in a cup of hot water to soak the brush in for a few minutes, or doing the same with Oxiclean, or with vinegar. Others use Dawn dish soap. Others use two-in-one shampoo and conditioner, or deodorizing pet shampoo, and others preferred to lather up the brush with a more heavily scented shaving cream and allow it to dry on the brushes overnight. I have done a combination of almost all of these, with other brand of brushes, but I have not tried the vinegar or the pet shampoo.

Just to be completely clear, I did not need to use any of these methods with this current brush, as it did not have a problem with the scent, but for your information this is what I did with my last brush (which had quite a stink)… I lathered the brush up two or three times with Dawn dish soap, once with Borax, twice with Oxiclean, twice with Pert shampoo/conditioner, and I lathered the brush up with Taylor of Old Bond Street’s Sandalwood shaving cream two times, then left the shaving cream on the brush overnight, and then after rinsing it in the morning the odor was gone. If you have a badger shaving brush which has a strong initial musky odor then hopefully some of these tips might help. You likely won’t need to do all of them, and based on my smell test after each of these methods, I think that the most helpful may have been the dawn dish soap and lathering with the shaving cream and leaving that on the brush overnight.

This is a good brush, it makes a nice lather, the bristles are soft, it does not have any significant badger stink, it is good quality, and it will get good use going forward. I like it!

The pads aren't really all that thick, but anything applying pressure on the neuroma feels like more than it is.

On the plus side, the cushion pads are well-designed and attach securely to the big toe and second toe via holes cut in the ends of the pads. Putting socks on over them is a little fussy, and is best done by gathering the sock clear up to the toe, then fitting it over the toe area first and then bringing it over the foot and up the ankle.
