text:
I am on the fence about this cleaner. I wouldn't buy it again. Snags insanely easily! A broken cuticle will pull out the strands. However, it does seem to pick up dust as you see the head become progressively darker, and the telescoping handle is great. My 5' self can easily dust vents on the ceiling. The head tends to roll with your movement so that if you are trying to slide it over some surfaces, it rolls likes a tire. This sounds like it would be ok, but it means there isn't enough contact with the surface to actually pick up the dust, instead it rolls over it and leaves it behind. I love the savings that comes with a re-usable head but hand washing is for the birds! I put it in a small mesh garment laundry bag and tossed it in the machine on the hand wash cycle. I followed the instructions to dry it by rolling it up in a towel, and then I hung it by a hook to continue drying and that seemed to work fine.
UPDATE: June 2018. Cindy from Proaller contacted me regarding my review and offered a refund or replacement. I wasn't expecting the company to reach out and appreciated their service in handling the matter.

text:
Effective. Really excited about these. Wish I had gotten them sooner. I'm only 3 years out of school, but have noticed that the volume settings on my computer have been creeping up. Hopefully the hearing loss is transient.

Chose these b/c most of the other earplugs I looked at seemed to have an NRR ~12dB or were unrated.

These noticeably cut down on the high pitched sounds of the suction and handpiece - So much so that I can no longer depend on my sense of hearing to tell if the drill is spinning fast enough, haha (We have a couple temperamental handpieces). But that is definitely a trade-off I'm willing to make. Unexpected side benefit: I feel more calm/relaxed while working - The high pitched sounds must have been overstimulating and making me feel amped up or something.

No problems hearing people talking. I think I can actually hear my assistant's voice better b/c the other sounds are dampened.

Comfortable enough (I haven't tried any others, so I have nothing for comparison). I leave them in all day. Ears can start to feel sore by the end of the day, but taking them out at lunch helps.

I like the unobtrusive design of the safety lanyard, but there isn't enough space in the carrying case for it unless I squish the earplugs (taking it on/off the plugs is not that easy either and seems to also involve a lot squishing/deforming of the plugs). title: Wish I had bought one sooner. Not just for those pregnant with twins.
text:
I have been suffering with middle back pain since 16 weeks pregnancy and started feeling lower back pain at around 34 weeks. All the back pain was greatly limiting my activity levels. I didn't order one until I started feeling lower back pain because it specifically touted being good for lower back pain. However, I now regret that decision.

Pros
- Great for upright activities like housework, walking and generally staying active. It relieves both my middle & lower back pain for a good period of time. (See cons for what it's not great for.)
- Comfortable. I wouldn't say that I forget it's on as I don't like restrictive clothing, but it doesn't irritate the skin or feel so restrictive that I can't handle it.
- It definitely helps take the pressure off my bladder & pelvis. I notice a huge difference when I take it off.
- For not having twins, I have a rather large bump. I'm able to bring it in one notch. It's nice to know if I grow larger, it will grow with me. Can't say the same for a lot of maternity clothing.

Cons
- I'm in the tech industry & spend a lot of time in front of the computer. It does not help with back pain associated with that.
- It's obviously not a replacement for your abdominal muscles - it doesn't rid pain forever, but certainly gives you more stamina.
- You can't wear it with v-neck tops, which I love. No matter what I do, the front straps show through.
- The package did not come with instructions for how to put it on. It's not easy to figure out on your own. Fortunately they have a great YouTube video. Wish they would provide a link to it in the package.
- The package & their website also don't provide advice on how to adjust the shoulder straps. I've had to play with them a bit to find a comfortable position.
- At the time of purchase it wasn't available through Amazon Prime. I wish Amazon would stock these or work with the merchant that sold it.

Generally very happy with this purchase & wish I had invested in one sooner.

title: Addition to, Not Replacement of Kitchen Towels
text:
The softness and appearance of these towels are great. They hold their shape much better than terry washrags too.

That being said, because they don't saturate with water as deeply as a terry towel [subjective to be sure], I have less confidence that they're doing the job of scrubbing -- mostly use for washing down counters and other kitchen surfaces. Since there are so many to the pack, I may end up using them for dusting and go back to more conventional washrags.

I've also heard that one shouldn't dry microfiber using dryer sheets due to residue buildup.

title: Nice Product
text: I recently purchased an aluminum outdoor table and chairs at my local grocery for use in our winter home. The intent was for the table to do dual duty - outside on nice days at the pool, and inside in the dining room the rest of the time. The first time we served dinner on the table we learned that the table has a rather pronounced topography based on how it is constructed. The central area is depressed and has a hole for an umbrella, and there are sections near the short ends that are likewise depressed. This is not a defect but rather how the thing  is made. I purchased the Comfort Shield to try to smooth out the tabletop. Fortunately the product is much larger than needed - such that I was able to make both a full tabletop size sheet and smaller sheets to put onto/into each depressed section. The result is a greatly smoothed surface that feels good under a tablecloth. My metal, outdoor, el-cheapo table is now a (semi) respectable dining room table.

title: Electrolyte Ice Cream?  Yes!
text:
I am a repeat buyer and a Junp fan for life. I originally got this for myself and have loved it, but when I discovered the benefits for my 93 year old relative, I found myself wanting to shout from the rooftops. Whether you are 9 or 99, Junp is the drink you should have in your kitchen!

I can rave all day about the good flavor, quality ingredients and the benefits to both a middle aged woman and old, old man, but what I want to share in this review is a use for it that very well may benefit many.

Junp Ice Cream!

1 C water
1 C milk
3 scoops Junp

Mix the above and pour into popsicle forms. When solid, pop out the popsicles, pulse them in a blender and viola!

Because of health issues we had to stop giving our relative his beloved Ice cream, but Junp jumped into the picture and saved the day!

title: Nearly Perfect
text:
When it comes to electrolytes, Junp is by far the best I have found.

I am on a mission to lose half my body weight this year which means I am exercising a LOT and replenishing my electrolytes is very important to me.

I have tried quite a few and none compare to Junp. The flavors are great. There is no salty flavor like so many have nor is there an after taste because of odd sweeteners. Every bottle is consistently good.

My only criticisms have to do with packaging. The scoop has to be put in handle first in order to go back in the container. This isn't really a major big deal but it would be nice to either have a place to put the scoop on the outside of the package or a scoop that would easily slide in scoop side first.

The other packaging issue is a bit more important and hopefully something they change. The wording (especially flavor wording) is not large enough nor in a contrasting color to be easily seen. For people with great eyesight, it probably isn't an issue, but anyone with vision problems will be playing a guessing game.

Despite the small things, as you can see in the photo, I am a repeat buyer and truly a fan. Junp is helping me Jump into My Best Self.

title: Super!  Simply Super!
text:
I have used electrolytes for years and tried many different kinds. Junp beats them all.

The flavor is consistent with every bottle I mix. Specifically, Wild Berry is very good. I look forward to trying the other flavors.

Besides flavor, I must comment on the price. Junp is the most economical of all the brands with high quality ingredients.

I highly recommend Junp and will be a customer for a long time to come.

title: Love this lamp!
text:
I just love this lamp! One of the reviews says that it's too short but I think its just perfect. With it sitting at the end of my couch, that has a recliner in each end, to read its just right. Any higher and it would make a glare on my glasses. With the diffuser, the silver grate looking thing, it keeps it from having a lot of glare when sitting below the head of it. It doesn't light up a whole room this way but it also keeps it from making a bright reflection on my TV screen like my other lamp did. The diffuser also makes it so that it puts out a cone of nice bright white light under and around it so when sitting next to you can have plenty of light to read without being bright enough to bother anybody else in the room. This makes it a more personal lamp kinda like the little lights over your seat in a airplane. If you want more light from it just take the diffuser off. This will double or almost triple the area that it lights up. But then it does make a lot of glare.

About the only thing I would change would be to put the switch on the column instead of under the head. That way it would be easier to reach while sitting next to it. And it had a little too much wire so when putting it together it was a bit difficult to get all of it poked inside the tube so I could get the head on it. Other than that its a great light.

title: Great product, works, but a bit expensive
text:
First, I rarely write long reviews, unless I really like a product or can’t stand one. I wasn’t given anything for this review and is just my honest experience. I gave this 5 stars, because it works for me. It would be a better value, if it was a 30 day supply, instead of a 20 days. I still give it 5 stars, because I have insomnia and it helps. I didn’t expect too much, but have a subscription for freshcaps Thrive 6, which has helped with my memory, which has been foggy. So I figured it was worth a try and wasn’t disappointed.

The first time I tried this, it definitely relaxed me and I actually slept 10-12 hours that night. I rarely sleep 6 hours and it was a complete shock. I didn’t wake multiple times. Although, I hadn’t slept well the nights prior and was why I ordered, but that is nothing new. Amazon was able to get it here quicker. So I went with them to try this product. I expected sleep, but not that much, but not complaining. I actually woke up refreshed. It hasn’t happened like that since, but I have been sleeping better. I do take other supplements with mushrooms, changed my diet and am more active. All of which could be factors that helped too, but I hadn’t had sleep like that in a long time. The only new thing was this product. The taste isn’t bad at all. I figured I would hate the taste, but wanted the benefits. I was able to get both. I mix it with 8oz of almond milk in a small blender. I put it in a blender, because it can clump up, but not with the blender. I have added mud/wtr with it a few times. It is definitely worth a try, even with the price. I will order again, but won’t take daily. I would recommend it for a stressful day, when you just need to relax and unwind. I already take many of the mushrooms in it, but the magnesium and botanicals definitely helped.

Mushrooms are high in antioxidants and help. If you want a calming mushroom that has a 60 day supply and is cheaper. I would recommend their Reshi caps or you can buy canister and make it like you would this product. The bottles and canisters come with a 60 day supply(60 capsules or a canister with 60 grams). The thrive 6 has Reishi, lions mane, Chaga and 3 other mushrooms. You may want to buy off amazon for a one time try. If you buy directly off the site. You will pay more, unless you subscribe. You can cancel anytime, but prime has a quicker delivery.

I wrote this review to help others decide. You may not have the same reaction as I did with sleep, but everything in it helps aid relaxation. I don’t like taking melatonin and this is a great alternative. Everything in it has benefits. Just do some research on the ingredients. Look into the benefits of mushrooms, because they have helped me. Hoping this can help others decide if it is right for them. The Freshcap site has more information on these mushrooms and this product. You may want to check their site for benefits of each one before you order. I hope this helped.

title: For the gentle, careful user ONLY
text: Bought these about a month ago, my first venture into "frameless" glasses. Been wearing framed reading glasses for many years, so I am no stranger as to how durable 'readers' are in day-to-day use. First, thing to know is that I do like the frameless concept that these offer. I have less head movement to look over the top of the lens for more distant objects (which I see clearly without correction). However, and don't you just know there is a 'however' - these glasses are no where near as durable as framed glasses. Wanted you to know that they have a really bad habit of fracturing the plastic lens if they are dropped even a short distance or grabbed while in the process of putting them on. They don't have to be mishandled very much to break the lens entirely right at the junction of where the securing screws are drilled through the plastic. I am not all that clumsy, but all previous framed glasses held up just fine to my needs for many, many months, whereas two (2) of the three (3) of these frameless glasses  have already wound up in the trash after just over a month of ownership. Yes I know they have a warranty but getting them replaced is not going to improve the durability. Used carefully I am sure they would be fine, but they are just not for older ham-handed guys...!

title: AMAZING!! MUST BUY!

I had ZERO motion sickness. I did not experience any nausea. I used them as a passenger and while driving. Seriously the best purchase I've made in years. I have told all of my friends about this amazing product. I have a wide face for a woman and they fit me just fine. They also fit my 12 year old daughter just fine as well. They are plastic and won't break so you can stretch them to fit you without worrying about breaking them.
